In the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries it was a town of the Golden Horde, with a mint whose coins bear the names of several khans. The river mouth connected the settlement with the wider Bug valley. By the sixteenth century the name Chapchakley had come to be used for the place.
simp_chinese: 巴利克莱位于奇奇克利亚河汇入南布格河之处，处在穿越黑海北岸草原的河流道路上。十四至十五世纪，它是金帐汗国的一座城镇，设有铸币所，所铸钱币上有多位汗的名字。河口将聚落同更广阔的布格河谷联系起来。到十六世纪，这里又被称为恰普恰克莱。

english:
Bālíng, the seat of Yuèzhōu, stands where Dòngtíng Lake and the Yangtze meet in northeastern Húnán, and the Xiāng River flows in from the south. Its landmark is Yuèyáng Tower on the western city gate, whose roots go back to the naval review tower of Lǔ Sù; Téng Zǐjīng rebuilt it in 1045–1046, and Fàn Zhòngyān's “Record of Yuèyáng Tower” made it famous across the empire, with poets of every dynasty after him adding their lines.

The Yuán made Yuèzhōu a route in 1276 and the Míng a prefecture in 1369. It was reduced to a department in 1376, when Bālíng County was folded into it, and restored as a prefecture, with Bālíng County revived, in 1381; in 1397 Lǐzhōu across the lake was attached to it, and was split off again in 1729. By the Qīng the Yuèzhōu prefecture belonged to the Yuè-Cháng-Lǐ circuit.
simp_chinese:
巴陵是岳州治所，位于湖南东北部洞庭湖与长江交汇处，湘江自南汇入。城西门上的岳阳楼是它的地标，前身相传是鲁肃检阅水军的阅军楼；庆历五至六年（1045—1046年）滕子京重修，范仲淹的《岳阳楼记》使它名闻天下，此后历代诗人在楼上留下诗篇。

元至元十三年（1276年）岳州改为路，明洪武二年（1369年）改为岳州府；洪武九年（1376年）降为州，巴陵县并入州，洪武十四年（1381年）复升为府，恢复巴陵县；洪武三十年（1397年）湖西的澧州划归岳州，雍正七年（1729年）又分出。清代岳州府隶岳常澧道。

english:
Balingen stands on the Eyach near the Swabian Jura. First recorded as Balginga in 863, it became the seat of the Zollern lordship of Schalksburg in the thirteenth century. In 1255 a new town was founded a short distance upstream from the older settlement, on a tongue of land between the Eyach and Steinach. It grew within walls, and in 1403 Württemberg purchased it; the former Zollern castle became the residence of its officials.

Plague repeatedly struck Balingen, and after an outbreak in the 1460s the inhabitants founded a confraternity in honour of St Sebastian. During the Poor Conrad uprising of 1514, rebels took control of the town. Fire brought further destruction in 1724 and again in 1809, when much of the town within the walls burned. Balingen was rebuilt with a regular street plan after these disasters.
simp_chinese:
巴林根位于施瓦本山地附近的艾亚赫河畔，863年的文献首次将它记作巴尔金加。十三世纪，这里成为霍亨索伦家族沙尔克斯堡领地的治所。1255年，新城建在旧聚落上游不远处，位于艾亚赫河与施泰纳赫河之间的狭长地带。城市在城墙内发展，1403年被符腾堡购得，原霍亨索伦城堡成为地方官员的驻地。

瘟疫多次袭击巴林根；1460年代的一次疫情过后，居民建立了纪念圣塞巴斯蒂安的兄弟会。1514年“穷康拉德”起义期间，起义者掌握了城镇。1724年和1809年的大火再次造成破坏，后一场火灾烧毁了城墙内的大部分建筑。灾后重建使巴林根形成了规整的街道布局。

english: Balışeyh lies on the central Anatolian plateau east of the Kızılırmak River. The settlement grew among open hills and agricultural land on the road between Ankara and the eastern interior. Its Ballı Baba mosque and tomb are associated with the early Turkish period; the building has traditionally been dated to the twelfth century. The mosque preserves a reminder of the religious communities that took root on the plateau.
simp_chinese: 巴勒谢伊位于克孜勒尔马克河以东的安纳托利亚高原，在安卡拉通往东部内陆的道路旁，周围是开阔丘陵与耕地。当地的巴勒巴巴清真寺和陵墓与突厥人早期定居有关，传统上认为建筑建于十二世纪。清真寺留下了宗教社群在高原扎根的痕迹。

english: The Balj flows through the Khentii highlands to join the Onon, one of the great headwaters of the Amur. Along its valley the northern coniferous forest gives way to Daurian forest steppe, with pine, larch and birch growing among open ground. The Balj and Galtai rivers meet amid a landscape of lakes and wetlands that provides habitat for many birds.
simp_chinese: 巴勒杰河流经肯特高地，汇入黑龙江重要源流鄂嫩河。沿着河谷，北方针叶林逐渐过渡为达乌尔森林草原，松树、落叶松和桦树生长在开阔地之间。巴勒杰河与嘎勒泰河交汇处周围有湖泊和湿地，为众多鸟类提供栖息地。

english:
The western Balkan Mountains rise as a rugged belt where Bulgaria meets Serbia, formed largely from folded rock and cut by deep valleys. Limestone gives the region extensive karst country: caves, gorges, cliffs, and seasonal waterfalls break up the wooded slopes. Magura is especially important for its extended post-Palaeolithic paintings, while the towering Belogradchik Rocks give the western range a dramatic silhouette. These features made the high ground a storehouse of water, shelter, and visual landmarks.

The western mountains also frame routes between the Danube lowlands and the interior valleys. Narrow defiles channeled travellers and armies, while forests offered concealment and pasture to communities living around the slopes. Larger mammals, among them brown bears, wolves, boar, chamois, and deer, remain part of this varied habitat. The range is therefore more than a boundary: settlements below its edge depended on the products above them, and the difficult terrain repeatedly shaped the movement of people across the Balkan Peninsula.
simp_chinese:
巴尔干山脉西段在保加利亚与塞尔维亚交界一带隆起，岩层褶皱与深切河谷构成崎岖地形。石灰岩形成了广泛的喀斯特景观，洞穴、峡谷、峭壁和季节性瀑布穿插在林木覆盖的山坡之间。马古拉洞以延续较长的旧石器时代后期壁画著称，高耸的贝洛格拉奇克岩群则赋予西段醒目的轮廓。水源、藏身空间与天然地标由此集中在这片高地。

西段山地也框定了多瑙河低地与内陆谷地之间的道路。狭窄山隘引导行旅与军队通过，森林则为山脚居民提供隐蔽处和牧场。棕熊、狼、野猪、岩羚羊和鹿等大型哺乳动物至今构成多样生境的一部分。山脉并非隔绝人迹的界线，山脚聚落依赖其上的资源，险峻地势也一再左右巴尔干半岛上的人员往来。

english: West of the great central peaks, the Balkan Mountains rise above the country of Vidin in a succession of wooded slopes and high ridges. Known in Bulgarian as Stara Planina, the Old Mountain, the range stretches eastward across Bulgaria toward the Black Sea. Rivers including the Lom and Ogosta descend from its northern side toward the Danube, cutting valleys through the foothills. Beech woods cover parts of the western mountains, giving way at higher elevations to open mountain meadows.
simp_chinese: 巴尔干山脉的西段耸立在维丁地区之上，林木覆盖的山坡和高峻的山脊绵延起伏。保加利亚人称这条山脉为“斯塔拉普拉尼纳”，意为“老山”；山岭向东横贯保加利亚，直抵黑海。洛姆河和奥戈斯塔河等河流从北坡流向多瑙河，在山麓切出一道道河谷。西部山地的部分坡面覆盖着山毛榉林，更高处则是开阔的山地草甸。

english: Southeast of Niš rises Suva Planina, the Dry Mountain, a long ridge overlooking the valleys of southern Serbia. Its highest peak, Trem, stands above steep cliffs and upland pastures. Oak forests cover the lower slopes, giving way to beech and fir higher on the mountain. Water is scarce on much of the limestone ridge, and the few springs are especially valuable to the herds that graze its high ground.
simp_chinese: 尼什东南方耸立着苏瓦普拉尼纳，即“干山”，绵长的山脊俯瞰塞尔维亚南部的河谷。最高峰特雷姆高出陡峭崖壁和高山牧场。低处山坡覆盖橡树林，往上则有山毛榉和冷杉。石灰岩山脊的大部分地方缺水，少数泉水对在高地放牧的畜群尤其宝贵。

english: North of the Sofia basin, the Iskar cuts across the Balkan Mountains in a deep and winding gorge. Forested slopes give way to steep rock walls, caves and narrow stretches beside the river. Farther downstream the Cherepish Monastery stands among the cliffs, a place of worship in the mountain valley. The Iskar continues north through the foothills towards the Danube, carrying water from its sources in the Rila Mountains across the Balkan chain.
simp_chinese: 索非亚盆地以北，伊什克尔河横切巴尔干山脉，形成深邃曲折的峡谷。林木山坡间露出陡峭岩壁、洞穴和河畔狭道。再向下游，切雷皮什修道院坐落在峭壁之间，是山谷中的宗教场所。伊什克尔河继续向北流过山麓，奔向多瑙河，将里拉山脉的源水带过巴尔干山系。

english: The central Balkan Mountains rise above the plains of northern Bulgaria in a long chain of wooded slopes and exposed summits. Rivers including the Vit and Osam begin in these highlands and descend towards the Danube. Through the Troyan Pass, the Roman Via Traiana crossed the range between Lower Moesia and Thrace. Forts and road stations once watched the route as it climbed from the valleys towards the ridge.
simp_chinese: 巴尔干山脉中段耸立在保加利亚北部平原之上，林木覆盖的山坡与裸露的山峰连成一道长岭。维特河和奥瑟姆河等河流发源于这片高地，向北流往多瑙河。罗马人修筑的图拉真大道穿过特罗扬山口，连接下默西亚与色雷斯。道路从谷地攀向山脊，沿途曾有堡垒和驿站守望。

english: The central Balkan Mountains reach their greatest height at Yumrukchal, a broad summit rising 2,376 metres above the valleys. Steep cliffs and deep ravines cut into its southern slopes, where beech and fir forests give way to meadows above the tree line. Water falling from the high ridges feeds streams on both sides of the range, while the rocky heights stand between the plains to the north and the valleys of Thrace.
simp_chinese: 巴尔干山脉中段的最高处是尤姆鲁克恰尔峰，宽阔的山顶高出海面2376米。南坡布满峭壁与深谷，山毛榉和冷杉林在林线之上让位于高山草甸。水流从高岭落下，汇入山脉两侧的溪流；岩石高地则横亘于北方平原与色雷斯河谷之间。

english:
Balkh, the ancient Bactra, lies in an oasis south of the Oxus and was once among the richest cities of Khorasan. In 1220 Genghis Khan sacked it, killed its people and razed every building that could be defended. When Ibn Battuta passed through around 1333, under the Kartid rulers, he found it dilapidated and empty, yet its mosques and colleges still showed the lapis-blue inscriptions of their builders. In 1370 Timur defeated his rival Amir Husayn at Balkh, and an assembly there acknowledged him as ruler; he later treated the city harshly again, and it never regained its former standing.

The Uzbeks under Muhammad Shaybani entered Balkh in 1506. The Safavids briefly drove them out in 1510, and the young Babur held the city for a year in 1511–1512 as a Safavid vassal until Bukhara's armies forced him to retire to Kabul. Safavid rule returned only from 1598 to 1601. In the seventeenth century the Bukharan prince Subhan Quli Khan raised a madrasa here, and in 1646 Shah Jahan's Mughal army turned the city into an imperial province, with the young Aurangzeb as its governor, only to lose it again in 1647. The nine-domed mosque known as Haji Piyada, the earliest Islamic monument yet identified in Afghanistan, and the shrine of Abu Nasr Parsa remained the city's landmarks.

Nader Shah took Balkh in 1736. After his death the local Uzbek Haji Khan declared it independent in 1747, and in the early nineteenth century the Qataghan dynasty of Khulm held the district while acknowledging Kabul only in name. Mazar-i-Sharif, nearby, slowly outgrew the old city.
simp_chinese:
巴尔赫即古代的巴克特拉，位于阿姆河以南的绿洲，曾是呼罗珊最富庶的城市之一。1220年成吉思汗洗劫此城，屠杀居民，把所有可以据守的建筑夷为平地。约1333年伊本·白图泰经过时，卡尔特人当政，他看到的城市残破无人，但清真寺和学校仍保留着建造者镌刻的青金石色铭文。1370年，帖木儿在巴尔赫打败对手艾米尔侯赛因，一次集会承认他为统治者；他后来再度严酷对待此城，巴尔赫再没有恢复往日地位。

1506年，穆罕默德·昔班尼率领乌兹别克人进入巴尔赫。1510年萨法维人曾短暂驱逐他们，青年巴布尔于1511至1512年作为萨法维的藩属据有此城，后被布哈拉的军队逼退到喀布尔。萨法维统治直到1598至1601年才再次出现。17世纪，布哈拉王子苏卜汉·库利汗在此建造了一所经学院，1646年沙贾汗的莫卧儿军队把巴尔赫改为帝国的一个省，青年奥朗则布任总督，次年便丢掉了它。被称为哈吉皮亚达的九穹顶清真寺是阿富汗已确认的最早伊斯兰建筑，与阿布·纳斯尔·帕尔萨陵一同是城中的地标。

1736年纳迪尔沙夺取巴尔赫。他死后，当地乌兹别克人哈吉汗于1747年宣布独立，19世纪初胡勒姆的卡塔甘王朝控制该地，只名义上承认喀布尔的宗主权。附近的马扎里沙里夫逐渐超过了这座老城。

english: Lake Balkhash stretches across an immense closed basin north of the Tian Shan. A narrow strait divides its waters into two contrasting halves: the western lake is nearly fresh, while the eastern part is brackish to salty. The Ili River enters from the south, spreading into a great delta of channels, marshes and reeds. These wetlands offer shelter to fish and waterbirds amid the arid plains and sands surrounding the lake.
simp_chinese: 巴尔喀什湖横卧在天山以北的巨大内流盆地中。一道狭窄水道将湖水分为性质不同的两半：西部近乎淡水，东部则呈微咸至咸水。伊犁河从南方注入，形成遍布河道、沼泽和芦苇的广阔三角洲。在湖泊周围干旱的平原与沙地之间，这片湿地为鱼类和水鸟提供栖身之处。

english: Balkonda lies in northern Telangana, near the Godavari River and the rocky uplands of the Deccan. Its fort appears in accounts of the Bahmani sultanate. In the fifteenth century the general Mahmud Gawan besieged rebels there; after they surrendered, the sultan granted them pardon. Such forts provided defensible centres for the rulers and military households competing for control of the Telangana country.
simp_chinese: 巴尔孔达位于特伦甘纳北部，靠近戈达瓦里河与德干的岩石高地。当地堡垒出现在巴赫曼尼苏丹国的记载中。十五世纪，将领马哈茂德·加万在此围攻叛军；叛军投降后，苏丹赦免了他们。这类堡垒为争夺特伦甘纳的统治者和军事家族提供易守的据点。

english: Balla arat lies in the volcanic country west of the Yarrowee River. The steep cone of Mount Elephant rises above the plains to the southwest, while Mount Buninyong stands farther east. The latter is a place of spiritual importance to the Keyeet Balug clan of the Wadawurrung. Wetlands around what is now Lake Wendouree supplied food and drinking water and were shared seasonally with other clans, providing a setting for cultural gatherings.
simp_chinese: 巴拉阿拉特位于亚罗威河以西的火山地带。西南方的象山陡峭锥体高出平原，更东面则矗立着巴宁扬山。巴宁扬山是瓦达乌伦人基伊特巴卢格氏族的重要精神之地。今日温杜里湖一带的湿地曾提供食物和饮水，并在特定季节与其他氏族共享，也是举行文化聚会的场所。

english:
Balladonia lies on the western edge of the Nullarbor Plain in Western Australia, where limestone country meets sandplain, mallee and scattered granite outcrops. Rain is scarce and surface water disappears quickly, but rock holes, soaks and occasional claypans made travel possible across an otherwise dry interior. The name is commonly explained as “big rock by itself,” recalling one of the landmarks that guided people through this open country.

Aboriginal groups of the western Nullarbor, including Ngatjumay and neighboring Kalaako and Mirning peoples, knew the springs, rock holes and seasonal foods along routes between inland and coast. They hunted, gathered and maintained kinship links across long distances. Deep caves in the district also preserve remains of extinct marsupials, showing that landscape and animals changed long before pastoral settlement.

European explorers crossed the area during the nineteenth century, but the place later identified as Balladonia was a station and telegraph stop. Its isolated identity still comes from the same basic geography: a rare cluster of water and shelter within a vast dry plain, where knowledge of tiny water holes determined survival and movement.
simp_chinese:
巴拉多尼亚位于西澳大利亚纳拉伯平原西缘，石灰岩地、沙原、桉灌丛和零散花岗岩露头在此相接。当地降雨稀少，地表水很快消失，岩石水洼、渗泉和偶有黏土洼地才使人能够穿越干旱内陆。地名通常解释为“独自矗立的大岩石”，让人想起引导旅人的地标。

西纳拉伯的原住民族群，包括恩加朱迈人以及邻近的卡拉科人和米尔宁人，熟悉内陆与海岸路线上的泉水、岩洞和季节性食物。他们狩猎、采集，并在遥远地点之间维系亲缘关系。县内深洞还保存已灭绝有袋类遗骸，说明当地生态在牧业进入以前已发生漫长变化。

十九世纪欧洲探险者穿越此地，后来被称为巴拉多尼亚的地点又成为牧场站和电报站。它孤立的身份仍来自同一种基本地理：辽阔干燥平原中少见的水源和遮蔽处，掌握微小水点位置决定旅程。

english: Ballaghaderreen sits near the meeting of the Mayo, Roscommon and Sligo borders, just off the old Dublin road toward Ballina. The Irish name means “the way of the little oak grove,” a reminder of the wooded route landscape from which the town grew. In this period the town and parish belonged to County Mayo. Its position on a major road made Ballaghaderreen a market and service centre. By 1837 it had about two hundred houses and was described as a rising post-town on the new mail coach route between Ballina and Longford. Friday markets and several annual fairs brought people from the countryside, while a courthouse, market house, and infantry barracks reinforced its local importance.
simp_chinese: 巴拉哈德里恩靠近梅奥郡、罗斯康芒郡和斯莱戈郡边界交汇处，也临近通往巴利纳的旧都柏林道路。爱尔兰语地名意为“小橡树林之路”，提示这座城镇最初生长于林木与道路并存的环境。这一时期，城镇和教区隶属梅奥郡。重要的道路位置使巴拉哈德里恩成为集市和服务中心。1837年，这里已有约二百座房屋，并因位于巴利纳至朗福德的新邮车路线而被记作逐渐兴起的邮镇。星期五集市与多次年度集市吸引乡村居民，法院、市场房和一座步兵营也加强了地方作用。

english:
Ballalapura lies on the Deccan plateau near the fort town of Penukonda, in the dry country of southern Andhra. Villages, fields and water tanks spread across the plateau, linked by roads to the larger forts and markets of the region.

Penukonda's fort was built by early Hoysala kings, and the town later passed to Vijayanagara. After Vijayanagara's defeat at Talikota in 1565, Tirumala moved the empire's capital to Penukonda, where it stayed until 1592. The town later came under the Nawabs, the Maratha chief Murari Rao, Tipu Sultan and the Nizam of Hyderabad.
simp_chinese:
巴拉拉普拉位于德干高原，靠近堡垒城镇彭努孔达，地处安得拉南部的干燥地带。高原上散布着村庄、田地与蓄水池，道路把它们与地区内较大的堡垒和市集相连。

彭努孔达的堡垒由早期曷萨拉国王修建，此后归入维查耶纳伽尔。1565年塔利科塔战败后，蒂鲁马拉把帝国都城迁到彭努孔达，直到1592年。此后该地先后处于纳瓦卜、马拉塔首领穆拉里·拉奥、蒂普苏丹和海得拉巴尼扎姆的统治之下。

english: Ballardong country lies northeast of Perth, extending across the Avon valley and into the inland wheatbelt. Ballardong Noongar people have lived around York for thousands of years. British settlement began at York in 1831; as explorers and settlers entered the Avon valley, relations with its Aboriginal inhabitants grew increasingly hostile.
simp_chinese: 巴拉东人的土地位于珀斯东北，横跨埃文河谷并延伸至内陆。巴拉东努恩加人在约克一带生活了数千年。1831年英国移民开始在约克定居；随着探险者和移民进入埃文河谷，他们与当地原住民之间的关系日益紧张。

english:
Ballarpur stands on the eastern bank of the Wardha River, where a fort preserves the memory of the Gond kingdom of Chanda. The stronghold is traditionally attributed to King Khandkya Ballal Shah in the fifteenth century. A rock temple in the riverbed below the fort is submerged when the Wardha rises in the flood season. The town was a royal seat before the Gond rulers established their later capital at Chanda.

According to local tradition, the king suffered from illness while living at Sirpur. His queen persuaded him to build a fort and palace across the Wardha, where she cared for him until he recovered. The dynasty subsequently made Chanda its chief seat, while Ballarpur retained its fort on the river. Gond rule in the wider country lasted until the Bhonsle Marathas took Chanda in the middle of the eighteenth century.
simp_chinese:
巴拉尔布尔位于瓦尔达河东岸，堡垒保存着贡德人钱达王国的记忆。传统将要塞的修建归于十五世纪的坎德基亚·巴拉尔沙阿。堡下河床中有一座岩石神庙，洪水季节瓦尔达河上涨时便被淹没。贡德统治者后来在钱达建立都城以前，这里曾是王室驻地。

当地传说称，国王在西尔普尔居住时患病，王后劝他在瓦尔达河对岸建造堡垒与宫殿，并在那里照料他直至康复。王朝随后将钱达作为主要驻地，而巴拉尔布尔保留了河畔堡垒。贡德人在广大地区的统治持续到十八世纪中叶，本斯勒马拉塔人夺取钱达为止。

english: Ballé lies in the Bakhounou country of the western Sahel, south of the desert edge. Its villages occupy dry plains where seasonal rains support grain cultivation and livestock. The surrounding region forms part of the old Wagadu country associated with the history of ancient Ghana. Communities here maintained connections across the Sahel between the Senegal and Niger basins, while the approach of the Sahara to the north made water and pasture especially dependent on the seasons.
simp_chinese: 巴莱位于西萨赫勒的巴库努地区，在沙漠边缘以南。村落分布在干燥平原，季节性降雨支持谷物种植与畜牧。周边属于古瓦加杜地区，与古加纳的历史相联系。当地社群在塞内加尔河和尼日尔河流域之间保持往来，北方临近撒哈拉使水源与牧草尤其依赖季节变化。

english:
Ballenstedt lies at the northern edge of the Harz and was an early seat of the Ascanian family. Count Esico founded a collegiate church here in the eleventh century; his descendants Otto the Rich and Albert the Bear established a Benedictine monastery on the site in 1123. Albert, who became the first ruler of Brandenburg, was buried in the abbey church.

During the Peasants' War the abbey was plundered, and Prince Wolfgang of Anhalt secularised it in 1525. He made Ballenstedt a residence and granted it town privileges in 1543. Imperial troops under Wallenstein plundered the town in 1626. Later the princes of Anhalt-Bernburg rebuilt the former monastery as a Baroque residence; Frederick Albert moved his court here in 1765 and established a theatre in 1788.
simp_chinese:
巴伦施泰特位于哈茨山北缘，是阿斯坎尼家族早期的驻地。埃西科伯爵于十一世纪在此建立共修教堂；他的后代富人奥托和熊阿尔布雷希特于1123年在原址创立本笃会修道院。后来成为勃兰登堡首位统治者的阿尔布雷希特葬于修院教堂。

农民战争期间，修道院遭到劫掠，安哈尔特的沃尔夫冈亲王于1525年将其世俗化。他将巴伦施泰特作为驻地，并于1543年授予城镇特权。1626年，华伦斯坦麾下的帝国军队劫掠此地。后来，安哈尔特-贝恩堡亲王将旧修院改建为巴洛克式居所；腓特烈·阿尔布雷希特于1765年迁来宫廷，并于1788年建立剧院。

english: Ballia lies where the Ghaghara meets the Ganges, on a river plain of shifting channels and sandy ground. Local tradition connects its name with the sage Valmiki, author of the Ramayana, and a shrine once associated with him that was lost to the water. Another explanation derives the name from ballua, a local word for the sandy soil.
simp_chinese: 伯利亚位于加格拉河与恒河交会处，河道在多沙的平原上不断变迁。当地传说将城名与《罗摩衍那》的作者蚁垤仙人联系起来，一座纪念他的圣祠曾被河水冲毁。另一种解释认为，地名来自当地表示沙地的词“巴卢阿”。

english: Ballou stands where the Falémé joins the Senegal River. Soninke and Fulani communities inhabit the surrounding river country, at the northern approach to Bambouk. Farther up the Falémé lies a region long renowned for its gold, which entered trading networks across the western Sudan and the Sahara. The rivers brought together the routes from Bambouk and the upper Senegal, linking this confluence with a much wider inland world.
simp_chinese: 巴卢位于法莱梅河与塞内加尔河交汇处，周围的河流地带住着索宁克人与富拉人，是通往班布克北部的入口。沿法莱梅河向上游行进，便进入长期以黄金闻名的地区；这里的金子流入横贯西苏丹与撒哈拉的贸易网络。班布克与塞内加尔河上游的道路在两河附近汇合，使这处河口与广阔的内陆世界相连。

english: Ballsh stands near the ruins of Byllis, once the chief city of the Illyrian Bylliones. Its great walls enclosed a hill above the Vjosa valley, and in Hellenistic times a theater, stadium and marketplace rose within them. Byllis declined after the Slavic incursions of the sixth and seventh centuries; stone from the old city was reused to build nearby Ballsh, whose name developed from that of Byllis. Under the Ottomans, Ballsh became the center of the Mallakastër district within the sanjak of Berat.
simp_chinese: 巴尔什靠近古城比利斯的遗址，后者曾是伊利里亚比利奥内斯人的主要城市。宏伟的城墙围绕着维约萨河谷上方的山丘，希腊化时代城内建有剧场、竞技场和市场。比利斯在六至七世纪斯拉夫人入侵后衰落，旧城石料被用于建造附近的巴尔什，其名称也由比利斯演变而来。奥斯曼统治下，巴尔什成为培拉特桑贾克所辖马拉卡斯特地区的中心。

english: Glenarm lies where a wooded valley opens onto the Antrim coast, facing the waters between Ireland and Scotland. The MacDonnells, whose power linked the glens with the Scottish islands, became the leading family of this shore. Sorley Boy MacDonnell expanded their holdings during the sixteenth century, and in 1603 his son Randal received a grant recognising his lands in the Route and the Glens. Randal, later Earl of Antrim, built Glenarm Castle in 1636, establishing a family seat beside the river and the sea.
simp_chinese: 格莱纳姆位于林木繁茂的山谷通向安特里姆海岸之处，面朝爱尔兰与苏格兰之间的海域。麦克唐纳家族的势力连接这些山谷与苏格兰群岛，成为海岸上的显赫家族。索利·博伊·麦克唐纳于十六世纪扩大领地；1603年，其子兰德尔获得承认他在鲁特与诸谷土地的授予。兰德尔后来成为安特里姆伯爵，于1636年建造格莱纳姆城堡，在河海之间确立家族驻所。

english: Antrim stands near the northern shore of Lough Neagh, where the Six Mile Water reaches the great lake. A castle and a market settlement developed beside the river, and an older round tower recalled the area's early ecclesiastical life. On 7 June 1798 the town became the scene of a major engagement in the United Irish rising in Ulster. Insurgents advanced toward Antrim from several directions, but troops and local defenders had gathered to meet them. The attack failed after fighting in the town, and the rising in the district was broken.
simp_chinese: 安特里姆位于内伊湖北岸附近，六码水河在此注入大湖。城堡和市集聚落在河畔发展，较古老的圆塔则让人想起当地早期的教会生活。1798年6月7日，阿尔斯特联合爱尔兰人起义的一场重要战斗在此发生。起义者从多个方向向安特里姆推进，但驻军和当地守卫者已集结迎敌。城镇内经过战斗，进攻失败，当地起义随之瓦解。

english:
Ballymore is a village in County Westmeath, on the road between Athlone and Mullingar, with the historic Hill of Uisneach nearby. In medieval times the place was known as the borough of Ballymore Lough Sewdy, after the nearby lake. A Gilbertine monastery founded here by the de Lacy family briefly served as the cathedral church of the diocese of Meath.

The Irish name An Baile Mór means 'big town'. Local place-names preserve older memories, such as Lugnacaha, which means 'the hollow of the battle'.
simp_chinese:
巴利莫尔是西米斯郡的一个村庄，位于阿森龙与穆林加尔之间的道路上，附近是历史悠久的乌斯尼赫山。中世纪时，这里因附近湖泊而称为“洛赫·苏迪的巴利莫尔”自治市。德拉西家族在此建立的吉尔伯廷修道院，曾短暂作为米斯教区的主教座堂。

爱尔兰语名称 An Baile Mór 意为“大城镇”。当地地名保留了更早的记忆，例如卢格纳卡哈意为“战斗之谷”。

english:
Balmaceda Lake lies in the interior of Chilean Patagonia and drains westward through the Hollemberg River. The steppe and lake country around it was home to the Aonikenk, whose language, Tehuelche, also called Aonekko 'a'ien, belongs to the Chonan family and was spoken across southern Patagonia.

Aonikenk groups followed herds of guanaco across the steppe and moved between river valleys and lakes, hunting and gathering according to the seasons. European voyages reached the Patagonian coast from the sixteenth century, while the interior remained largely outside colonial control for much of the colonial period.
simp_chinese:
巴尔马塞达湖位于智利巴塔哥尼亚内陆，湖水向西经奥列姆贝格河流出。湖泊周围的草原与湖区是奥尼肯克人的家园，他们使用的特韦尔切语又称 Aonekko 'a'ien，属于琼语系，流行于巴塔哥尼亚南部。

奥尼肯克各群体沿草原追随原驼群，依季节在河谷与湖泊之间迁移，以狩猎和采集为生。欧洲航行者自十六世纪起抵达巴塔哥尼亚海岸，而内陆长期大体在殖民统治之外。

english:
Balok Bay lies in the seas around Sumatra and Bangka, part of the Indonesian archipelago between the Indian and Pacific oceans. Indonesia contains more than seventeen thousand islands, so its waters are broken into straits, coastal passages and broad shallow seas rather than forming one open maritime space. For communities on Sumatra’s eastern coast and Bangka, movement by water links river mouths, fishing grounds and island settlements across a region shaped by tides and monsoon winds.

The adjacent seas have long carried trade between the archipelago, mainland Southeast Asia and more distant markets. Shipping remained essential to island connections, while fishing and coastal exchange supplied everyday markets. Monsoon winds timed voyages between the Strait of Malacca and the Java Sea. The Straits of Malacca have also retained a security concern: despite patrols, piracy has repeatedly affected traffic in parts of these waters. Balok Bay sits within this larger world of local fishing, coastal exchange and strategic sea routes.
simp_chinese:
巴洛克湾位于苏门答腊与邦加附近的海域，属于印度洋和太平洋之间的印度尼西亚群岛。全国拥有超过一万七千座岛屿，海面因此被分割成海峡、沿岸水道与宽广浅海，而非一片开放无阻的水域。对苏门答腊东岸和邦加的社群来说，水路连接着河口、渔场与岛屿聚落，往来节奏又受潮汐和季风影响。

周边海域长期承载群岛、东南亚大陆和远方市场之间的贸易。航运始终是岛际联系的基础，捕鱼与沿岸交换则供应日常市场。季风决定马六甲海峡与爪哇海之间的航期。马六甲海峡还存在持续的安全压力：尽管有巡逻行动，海盗活动仍多次影响部分水域的往来。巴洛克湾因此处在一个由地方捕捞、沿岸交换与战略航道共同构成的海洋世界之中。

english: The Balotiponé, also known as Umutina, are an Indigenous people of the upper Paraguay basin. Their language belongs to the Bororo family of the Macro-Jê stock. Their homeland includes the country of the Sepotuba and Bugres rivers, tributaries of the Paraguay, where forested banks and waterways connect the uplands with the vast wetlands farther south.
simp_chinese: 巴洛蒂波内人也称乌穆蒂纳人，是巴拉圭河上游流域的原住民族。他们的语言属于马科罗热语族的博罗罗语系。家园包括塞波图巴河和布格里斯河地区，这两条河都是巴拉圭河的支流；森林覆盖的河岸与水道将高地同更南方广阔的湿地连接起来。

english: Balrampur stands on the Rapti River in Awadh, near ancient Shravasti. Buddhist tradition remembers this country through the story of Angulimala, a robber who wore a necklace of fingers before the Buddha brought about his transformation. In the Mughal era Balrampur was the seat of an estate held by the Janwar Rajputs, one of the great landed houses of Awadh.
simp_chinese: 伯尔拉姆布尔坐落在阿瓦德的拉普蒂河畔，靠近古老的舍卫城。佛教传统在这片土地上记述了鸯掘摩罗的故事：他原是一名佩戴手指项链的强盗，后来受佛陀感化。莫卧儿时期，伯尔拉姆布尔是詹瓦尔拉杰普特家族的领地驻所，这一家族是阿瓦德的大地主之一。

english: The Barlyk Mountains rise on the eastern side of the Dzungarian Gate, the broad passage between the Alakol basin and Dzungaria. Their ridges and valleys frame a landscape of dry slopes, grassland and streams. The Tastı River runs through the mountains in a stony valley. Winds funnel through the open gate between Barlyk and the Dzungarian Alatau, making the passage a distinctive feature of the region.
simp_chinese: 巴尔鲁克山耸立在准噶尔门东侧；这道宽阔通道连接阿拉湖盆地与准噶尔。山脊和谷地之间分布着干燥坡地、草原与溪流，塔斯特河流经布满卵石的山谷。气流穿过巴尔鲁克山与准噶尔阿拉套山之间的开口，使这道山门成为当地独特的地理特征。

english: Balta stands on the Kodyma River in the borderlands of Podolia. For much of its history the river divided two settlements: Ottoman Balta on one bank and Józefgród, belonging to the Polish Crown, on the other. The frontier made the crossing a meeting place for merchants and a point of friction between rival powers. In 1768 Russian troops pursuing Polish confederates crossed the frontier and burned Balta. The incident helped bring on war between Russia and the Ottoman Empire. Józefgród received a town charter in 1776; by the end of the century both banks had come under Russian rule, and the settlements were united in 1797.
simp_chinese: 巴尔塔坐落在波多利亚边地的科德马河畔。历史上，这条河长期分隔着两座居民点：一岸是奥斯曼帝国的巴尔塔，另一岸是波兰王冠领地的约瑟夫格鲁德。边界让渡口成为商人相遇之处，也使它处在大国争端的前沿。1768年，追击波兰邦联军的俄军越过边界，焚毁巴尔塔。这一事件促成了俄国与奥斯曼帝国之间的战争。约瑟夫格鲁德于1776年获得城市特许状；到十八世纪末，两岸均已归俄国统治，两座居民点于1797年合并。

english: Baltas takes its name from a Bashkir hereditary landholder, the father of Kuluy Baltachev. The village was also known by names connected with the Tanyp and with Kuluy, who served as headman of the Kara-Tabyn district from 1759 to 1780. During Pugachev's rebellion he supported the government, and rebels burned his house. In 1834 the village had four watermills and a district office, while local communities maintained Muslim religious life and schools.
simp_chinese: 巴尔塔斯因一位巴什基尔世袭土地持有者得名，他是库卢伊·巴尔塔切夫的父亲。村庄也有与塔内普和库卢伊有关的名称；库卢伊于1759至1780年担任卡拉—塔宾辖区首领。普加乔夫起义期间，他支持政府，起义者焚毁了他的房屋。1834年，村中有四座水磨和辖区办事处，当地社群也维持着穆斯林宗教生活和学校。

english:
Bălți stands where the Răuțel joins the Răut, amid the wetlands from which its name is commonly derived. A Moldavian market settlement grew here in the northern country between the Prut and Dniester. The date of its beginnings is disputed, but travellers and military accounts mention Bălți in the seventeenth century.

In 1652 Timish Khmelnytsky, son of the Cossack hetman Bohdan Khmelnytsky, stopped here; an Italian traveller described the settlement in 1657. Saint Nicholas Church was completed in 1795. The Treaty of Bucharest brought Bălți and eastern Moldavia under Russian rule in 1812. Tsar Alexander I visited in 1818, the year the settlement received town status. Its market and river setting helped shape the town that emerged from the surrounding Moldavian countryside over the centuries.
simp_chinese:
伯尔齐位于勒乌策尔河汇入勒乌特河之处，周围的湿地通常被认为是其名称的来源。摩尔达维亚的一处集市聚落在此兴起，坐落于普鲁特河与德涅斯特河之间的北部地区。聚落始建年代尚有争议，但17世纪的旅行和军事记载已提到伯尔齐。

1652年，哥萨克盖特曼博赫丹·赫梅利尼茨基之子蒂米什曾在此驻留；1657年一位意大利旅行者描述了这处聚落。圣尼古拉教堂于1795年建成。1812年《布加勒斯特条约》使伯尔齐和摩尔达维亚东部归入俄罗斯。沙皇亚历山大一世于1818年到访，同年此地获得城市地位。市场和河流环境塑造了这座从周围乡村中发展起来的城镇。

english: Baluba is a name for Luba communities of the Kasai country. During the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries, Luba-speaking peoples spread through the savannas and river basins of the Kasai and Katanga, giving rise to communities with distinct local histories. In the Kasai, their settlements and chiefdoms lay among the valleys of the Lulua and Lubilash and their many tributaries.
simp_chinese: 巴卢巴是开赛地区卢巴社群的名称。十七至十八世纪，使用卢巴语的各群体逐渐分布到开赛和加丹加的草原与河流流域，形成各有地方历史的社群。在开赛地区，他们的聚落和酋长领地散布于卢卢阿河、卢比拉什河及众多支流的河谷之间。

english: The Balui is an upper branch of the Rajang River, flowing through the forested interior of northern Borneo. Kayan, Kenyah and Kajang communities established longhouses along its valleys, building substantial dwellings from durable ironwood. Their settlements stood along waterways that connected neighboring groups, while paths crossed the ridges separating the Balui from other rivers of the highlands.
simp_chinese: 巴鲁伊河是拉让河上游的一条支流，流经婆罗洲北部森林覆盖的内陆。加央、肯雅和卡让社群沿河谷建立长屋，以坚固耐久的铁木建造宽大的居所。聚落坐落在连接邻近群体的水道旁，小径则穿过山脊，通往高地其他河流。

english: Balya lies in the hill country of northwestern Anatolia, in the Karasi district of Balıkesir Province. Its hills are wooded, and small villages occupy the valleys around the central town. The town served the surrounding countryside, and routes linked it with the old roads between the Aegean hinterland and the Marmara region.
simp_chinese: 巴利亚位于安纳托利亚西北部的卡拉斯地区，属巴勒克埃西尔省。山丘林木茂密，小村落分布在中心市镇周围的谷地中。市镇服务周边乡野，道路把这里与爱琴海内陆和马尔马拉地区之间的古道连接起来。

english:
Balykchy stands at the western end of Lake Issyk-Kul, about 1,900 metres above sea level. Roads from the Chu valley, the Naryn valley and the lake's northern and southern shores meet in the surrounding basin. The lake is large and slightly saline, surrounded by high mountains and fed by rivers descending from the Tian Shan. Winter ice and deep snow close high passes, while seasonal pastures open during summer.

Kirghiz pastoralists used the lake basin for grazing, fishing and movement between mountain valleys. The western end controlled access to the Chuy lowland and the routes toward the Chinese frontier. The site remained a small camp and crossing point.
simp_chinese:
巴雷克奇位于伊塞克湖西端，海拔约一千九百米。楚河谷地、纳伦河谷及环湖南北道路在附近盆地交会。湖泊面积广阔、水略咸，四周天山河流汇入，冬季冰雪封闭高山隘口，夏季牧场则向高地展开。

吉尔吉斯牧民利用湖盆放牧、捕鱼，并在山谷之间迁徙。西端控制楚河低地与通往中国边境的道路。这里只是小营地与渡口，商旅和牧民在不同季节利用草地与湖岸。

english:
Balyktyg lies in the mountainous country of Tuva in southern Siberia, within the basin of the Maly Yenisei. Forested ridges, high pasture and narrow river valleys break the land into separate routes. Deep winter snow and frozen rivers turn movement toward lower valleys, while the short summer opens higher grazing. Fur-bearing animals, fish and livestock supplied a mixed livelihood.

From the seventh to thirteenth centuries the Yenisei Kyrgyz dominated much of this region. Mongol and Yuan rule followed, then the Northern Yuan and competing Oirat khanates. Tuva’s high valleys remained a frontier of pastoral movement, tribute and caravan travel rather than a land of large towns.

The Khotgoid and Dzungar khanates contended for the region until the Qing incorporated Tuva as Tannu Uriankhai in 1758. Local herders continued to move between seasonal pastures and maintained Buddhist and shamanic practices. Balyktyg’s early history belongs to this highland world of forest, river crossings and shifting pastoral authority.
simp_chinese:
巴雷克特格位于西伯利亚南部图瓦的山地，处在小叶尼塞河流域。林脊、高山牧场和狭窄河谷把土地分成不同路线。深冬积雪与冻结河流迫使人们转向低谷，短暂夏季则开放更高草场。毛皮动物、鱼类和牲畜共同支撑混合生计。

七至十三世纪，叶尼塞黠戛斯控制这一地区的很大部分。此后先后出现蒙古与元朝统治，以及北元和相互竞争的卫拉特诸汗国。图瓦高谷长期是游牧移动、贡赋与商队往来的边地，而非大城市密集之区。

浩特辉特与准噶尔汗国争夺该地，直到清朝在1758年把图瓦纳入唐努乌梁海。地方牧民继续往返季节性草场，并保持佛教与萨满信仰。巴雷克特格的早期历史属于这片由森林、渡口和变动不居的牧业权力构成的高地世界。

english: Balyktykol is a saline lake in the steppe south of the Irtysh. Long and bent in outline, it receives a tributary of the Shagan at its southeastern end. Another salt lake, Karabastuz, lies to the south. Balyktykol freezes in November and opens again in spring, a seasonal change that marks the rhythm of its shallow waters amid the surrounding open country.
simp_chinese: 巴雷克特科尔是额尔齐斯河南面的草原咸水湖。湖形狭长，中部弯曲，沙甘河的一条支流从东南端注入；另一座盐湖卡拉巴斯图兹位于其南方。巴雷克特科尔通常在十一月结冰，春季解冻，季节变化为周围开阔的草原增添了鲜明的节律。

english: The coast around the Yeya spit lies between the Sea of Azov and the Yeya estuary, where fisheries and steppe routes met. In 1777–1778 Russian forces built a fort at Chebakleya, near the base of the spit, as a reserve residence for the Crimean khan Shahin Giray. A wooden palace was moved there, while fishing settlements on the spit caught and salted fish. Nearby, a market associated with Shahin Giray served trade with the Nogais, bringing merchants and herders together on this coastal frontier.
simp_chinese: 叶亚沙嘴周围海岸介于亚速海与叶亚河口湾之间，渔业和草原道路在此相遇。1777—1778年，俄军在沙嘴根部附近的切巴克列亚修筑堡垒，作为克里米亚汗沙欣·格莱的备用驻地。一座木宫殿被迁到这里，沙嘴上的渔业聚落则捕鱼并腌制。附近与沙欣·格莱有关的集市供诺盖人交易，使商人与牧民在这片海岸边疆相聚。

english: Bam lies in an oasis on the southern edge of the Iranian plateau. Underground qanat channels brought water to its fields and settlements, and the fortified town of Arg-e Bam rose above them in walls of earth. Bam prospered between the seventh and eleventh centuries at a crossroads of trade routes and was known for silk and cotton garments. Under Shah Abbas I, Ganj Ali Khan used the citadel as a base for campaigns into Baluchistan. In 1794 the Zand ruler Lotf Ali Khan fled to Bam after losing Kerman, only to be seized by its governor and handed over to his Qajar enemies.
simp_chinese: 巴姆位于伊朗高原南缘的绿洲中。地下坎儿井将水引向田地和聚落，土墙筑成的巴姆城堡耸立其上。七至十一世纪，巴姆凭借商路交汇之利兴盛，以丝绸和棉制服装闻名。阿拔斯一世时期，甘杰阿里汗以城堡为据点，向俾路支斯坦发动军事行动。1794年，赞德王朝统治者洛特夫阿里汗失去克尔曼后逃到巴姆，却被当地总督抓获，交给了卡扎尔敌人。

english: Bam is a settlement in the uplands east of Esfarayen, among villages and valleys of northern Khorasan. Archaeological sites in the surrounding country include old fortified places and mounds, evidence of occupation stretching back well before the Islamic period. The village shares its name with the famous city of Bam far to the south, but belongs to a different mountain landscape on the northern edge of Khorasan.
simp_chinese: 巴姆是埃斯法拉延以东高地上的一处聚落，坐落在呼罗珊北部的村庄与山谷之间。周边考古遗址包括旧堡垒和土丘，显示远在伊斯兰时代以前这里就有人居住。它与远在南方的著名巴姆城同名，却属于呼罗珊北缘截然不同的山地景观。

english: Bam Lake lies north of the Nyenchen Tanglha mountains in the lake country of northern Tibet. Its enclosed basin holds salt water at an elevation of more than 4,500 metres. Surrounded by the broad uplands of the Changtang, the lake is one of many whose waters collect in high interior basins rather than flowing to the ocean.
simp_chinese: 巴木错位于念青唐古拉山北麓的藏北湖区，海拔超过4500米，是封闭盆地中的一座咸水湖。湖泊四周是广阔的羌塘高地；这里许多湖泊的水汇集于高原内陆盆地，不流入海洋。

english:
Bama, historically written with a character that adds the mountain radical to the first syllable, lies in the rolling country of northwestern Guangxi beneath Bama Mountain. The landscape combines limestone hills, deep valleys, small basins and the Panyang River. Springs, caves, forest and narrow fields shaped settlement, while roads followed valleys through the wider Hechi region. The broad Panyang valley remained the principal watered river corridor.

In 1528 Wang Yangming reorganized the former Tianzhou territory after local unrest. The Ming administration established the Bama native patrol office together with Jiazuan and Wangan offices. These posts controlled communities from the Zhuang and Yao borderland through local leaders, taxes and routes. The Qing continued a system of native offices alongside regular county administration, adapting central authority to dispersed mountain settlements.

Farming families combined rice, maize, beans and forest products, with river water used for irrigation. The river supplied fish and seasonal irrigation. Yao subgroups including Bunu, Nuomang and Nuonuo lived in different parts of the district, each with its own speech and customs. Bama Mountain and the Panyang valley long provided the shared frame for these communities, linking upland villages through markets, marriage and seasonal paths.
simp_chinese:
岜马位于广西西北部起伏山地，处在巴马山下。这里有石灰岩丘陵、深谷、小盆地和盘阳河，泉眼、洞穴、森林与狭小田地决定聚落位置，道路则沿谷地通往河池各地。盘阳河谷始终是最重要的水源通道。

1528年，王阳明在处理田州旧地动荡后重整行政，明朝设立岜马土巡检司，并设甲篆、万冈等土巡检司共同控制壮瑶边地。这些机构通过地方首领、赋税和道路管理分散山村。清代继续把土司制度与州县行政结合，以适应当地地形和社会。

农耕家庭兼用稻米、玉米、豆类和林产，河水用于灌溉，也提供鱼类和季节性用水。瑶族中的布努、诺芒和诺诺等支系分布在县域不同地带，各自保留语言与习俗。巴马山与盘阳河谷长期构成这些社群的共同框架，以市场、婚姻和季节性道路联系山间村落。

english:
Bamako lies on the Niger River on the edge of the Manding country, where the fertile valley gave its early people a rich food supply and the trade in gold, ivory, kola nuts and salt. By the eleventh century the empire of Ghana dominated the area, and later the Mali Empire.

The kafu, the small chiefdom, of Bamako was founded about 1650 by the Niare family, perhaps linked to a Soninke man named Bamba Sanogo. The Toure and Drave families, mostly clerics and merchants, were also prominent in the early town, which was a client of the Bambara Empire of Segou. When the Scottish explorer Mungo Park came in 1806 he estimated that Bamako had 6,000 inhabitants, a size like many commercial towns across West Africa at the time.
simp_chinese:
巴马科位于尼日尔河畔、曼丁地区的边缘，肥沃的河谷给早期居民提供了充足的食物，也带来黄金、象牙、可乐果和盐的贸易。11世纪时，加纳帝国控制了这一带，后来是马里帝国。

巴马科的卡富，即小型酋邦，约在1650年由尼亚雷家族建立，他们可能与一个名叫巴姆巴·萨诺戈的松尼克人有关。图雷和德拉维两个家族多为神职人员与商人，在早期城镇中同样显赫，而这座城镇是塞古的班巴拉帝国的附庸。苏格兰探险家蒙戈·帕克1806年来到这里，估计巴马科有6000居民，规模与当时西非许多商业城镇相仿。

english: The Bamangwato are a Tswana people whose history is closely tied to the hills and plains around Shoshong. Their chief Mathiba led followers north to this country in the eighteenth century. A dispute within his family saw his son Tawana move towards Lake Ngami, where the Batawana established themselves, while Khama became chief of the Bangwato in the 1790s. Later, under Kgari, the Bangwato lived for a time at Mabele-a-pudi north of Serowe; the upheavals of the 1820s brought further movement through the region.
simp_chinese: 巴曼瓜托是茨瓦纳人的一支，历史与绍雄附近的山丘和平原紧密相连。十八世纪，首领马蒂巴率追随者北迁至此。家族内部的争斗促使他的儿子塔瓦纳迁往恩加米湖，巴塔瓦纳人在那里立足；另一子卡马则于1790年代成为班瓜托人的首领。后来在卡里执政时，班瓜托人一度住在塞罗韦以北的马贝莱阿普迪；1820年代的动荡又促使人们在这一带继续迁徙。

english:
Bamba is a riverside place in the Bourem Cercle of Mali's Gao Region. It lies on the Niger about 190 kilometres east of Timbuktu and 230 kilometres northwest of Gao, within the long corridor where boats, livestock and desert trade meet. The river creates a narrow band of water, pasture and cultivated land in the surrounding Sahel, while seasonal flooding renews channels, ponds and fields.

Villages along the bank combine millet, rice and vegetable cultivation with fishing. Bozo fishers work the river and sell dried fish, Songhai farmers occupy the floodplain, and Tuareg herders move with livestock through the dry country beyond it. Their exchanges tied grain, fish, dairy goods, salt and animals into regional markets. Boat traffic connected Bamba with Timbuktu, Gao and the wider Niger bend.

The settlement belongs to a much older pattern of riverine and pastoral life. Its location on the northern bank allowed control of crossing places and access to flood recession pasture. Rather than a fixed frontier between farmers and nomads, the area depended on negotiated access to water, fields and routes, making cooperation and conflict part of the same social landscape.
simp_chinese:
班巴是马里加奥区布勒姆圈的河岸地点，位于尼日尔河畔，东距通布图约190公里，东南距加奥约230公里，处在水上交通、牲畜迁徙与沙漠贸易交会的长走廊。河流在萨赫勒环境中形成狭窄的水源、牧场和耕地带，季节洪水又更新水道、水塘与田野。

沿岸村庄兼营小米、水稻和蔬菜种植与捕鱼。博佐渔民在河中作业并出售干鱼，桑海农人占据泛滥平原，图阿雷格牧民则带牲畜进入更远的干旱地区。粮食、鱼类、乳品、盐和牲畜通过交换进入区域市场，船只又把班巴同通布图、加奥及尼日尔河湾各地相连。

聚落属于更古老的河岸与牧业生活格局。它位于北岸，便于控制渡口和利用洪水退后的牧场。这里并非农人与牧民之间固定的边疆，水源、田地和道路都依靠不断协商的通行权，合作与冲突共同构成同一社会景观。

english:
Bambara Maoundé lies on the Gourma plain south of Timbuktu, on the road toward Douentza. The surrounding land is dry Sahelian pasture with seasonal pools, scattered wells and low scrub. The name joins “Bambara,” identifying the Bamanan-speaking founder, with a Fulfulde word for “great.” Tuareg communities remember the village by the founder’s name, Hoddaré. Its population grew through meetings of Bambara, Fulani, Tuareg and other Sahelian peoples.

The rural commune spreads across dozens of villages and pastoral fractions. Families combine millet farming with herding, fishing, gathering and long-distance trade. Water determines settlement more than soil: wells must serve both people and cattle, while herds move to distant pastures after rain. Routes to Timbuktu and Douentza connect the Gourma communities with grain markets and oasis towns.

Lake Banzena becomes especially important late in the dry season. Its water draws Gourma elephants as well as livestock and herders, concentrating animals and people around a shrinking pool. Bambara Maoundé therefore belongs to a landscape of scarce but shared water, where villages, pastoralists and wildlife follow the same seasonal corridors across a broad Sahelian plain.
simp_chinese:
班巴拉芒代位于通布图以南的古尔马平原，处在通往杜恩察的道路上。周围是干旱萨赫勒牧场，散布季节水塘、水井和低矮灌丛。名称由“班巴拉”和富拉语“伟大”组成，前者指讲巴马纳语的奠基者。图阿雷格人则用奠基者霍达雷之名称呼村庄。当地人口由班巴拉人、富拉尼人、图阿雷格人及其他萨赫勒社群汇聚形成。

乡村辖区横跨数十座村庄和牧户群体。家庭把粟作同放牧、捕鱼、采集和远途贸易结合起来。水源比土壤更决定聚落：水井必须同时服务居民和牛群，雨后的畜群则迁往远处牧场。通往通布图与杜恩察的道路，把古尔马社群同粮食市场和绿洲城镇联系起来。

班泽纳湖在旱季后段尤其重要。湖水吸引古尔马象群以及牲畜和牧民，使动物与人在缩小水面周围集中。班巴拉芒代因而属于水源稀少却共享的水文景观，村庄、牧民和野生动物沿相同季节走廊穿越广阔萨赫勒平原。

english:
Bamberg lay on the two arms of the Regnitz, with the cathedral hill above and the island town of burghers, gardeners and vintners below. Its bishopric was founded by Henry II in 1007, and in the middle of the thirteenth century Bishop Henry of Bilversheim received sovereign rights from Frederick II and became the first prince-bishop, so that the bishop ruled the town as well as the church. Floods were a constant danger: in July 1342 the Magdalene flood swept away a bridge.

In January 1430 the Hussites advanced on Bamberg. The cathedral chapter fled with its treasure to the Giechburg and the bishop withdrew to Carinthia, while the town paid a ransom of 12,000 gulden to escape burning. Citizens' revolt against the prince-bishop's power failed in the Immunities Dispute of the fifteenth century, and in the Peasants' War of 1525 rebels attacked the cathedral hill and plundered the canons' houses. The Constitutio Criminalis Bambergensis of 1507 set burning as the penalty for witchcraft. Under Prince-Bishop Johann Georg II Fuchs von Dornheim, trials reached their height: at least 884 people in the bishopric were put to death between 1612 and 1631, among them Mayor Johannes Junius, who was held in the witch-house built in 1627 and executed in 1628. Swedish troops entering in February 1632 ended it. The war cut the population from about 12,000 to 9,600.

Under Lothar Franz von Schönborn and Friedrich Carl von Schönborn the baroque age brought the New Residence, the Lower Bridge and Vierzehnheiligen pilgrimage church. A flood on 27 February 1784 wrecked the mill quarter and the new Sees bridge. The prince-bishopric passed to Bavaria in 1802 and 1803.
simp_chinese:
班贝格坐落在雷格尼茨河的两条支流之间，上面是大教堂山，下面是市民、园艺师和葡萄种植者聚居的岛城。主教区由亨利二世于1007年创立；13世纪中叶，比尔弗斯海姆的海因里希主教从腓特烈二世手中获得主权，成为第一位采邑主教，主教从此既管教会，也统治城市。洪水是经常的威胁：1342年7月的抹大拉洪水冲走了一座桥。

1430年1月，胡斯派逼近班贝格。大教堂圣职团带着珍宝逃往吉希堡，主教退往克恩滕，城镇则付出一万两千古尔登赎金，免遭焚毁。15世纪市民反抗主教权力的“豁免权之争”失败了；1525年农民战争中，起义者攻击大教堂山，抢掠教士们的住宅。1507年的《班贝格刑事法典》规定以火刑处置巫术罪。约翰·格奥尔格二世·富克斯·冯·多恩海姆任采邑主教期间，审判达到顶点：1612至1631年，主教领内至少有884人被处死，其中包括市长约翰内斯·尤尼乌斯，他被关在1627年建成的“女巫监狱”，1628年被处决。1632年2月瑞典军队入城，才结束了这一切。战争使人口从约一万两千人降到九千六百人。

在洛塔尔·弗朗茨·冯·申博恩和弗里德里希·卡尔·冯·申博恩治下，巴洛克时代带来了新宫、下桥和十四圣徒朝圣教堂。1784年2月27日的洪水冲毁了磨坊区和新建的泽斯桥。1802至1803年，采邑主教领并入巴伐利亚。

english: Bamgweolo lies in the vast wetlands of Bangweulu, a shallow basin of open water, marshes and seasonally flooded grasslands. The Chambeshi feeds the swamps, whose waters leave through the Luapula towards Lake Mweru. As the floods rise and retreat, islands and channels emerge within a landscape where the horizon stretches across water and reeds.
simp_chinese: 班圭奥洛位于班韦乌卢广阔的湿地中。这片浅盆地由开阔水面、沼泽和季节性淹没的草地组成。谦比希河注入沼泽，河水再经卢阿普拉河流往姆韦鲁湖。洪水涨落之间，岛屿和水道时隐时现，芦苇与水面一直延伸到远方的地平线。

english: Bampton is a small market town in the hills of Devon, with a long tradition of livestock trading and cloth making. Its medieval castle overlooked the settlement, while fairs brought animals from the surrounding countryside. During the Civil War farmers and townspeople formed a local Clubmen movement to defend their property from both armies. Fighting reached Bampton in 1645, leaving much of the town damaged.
simp_chinese: 班普顿是德文郡丘陵中的小集镇，有悠久的牲畜交易和制呢传统。中世纪城堡俯瞰聚落，周围乡村的牲畜被带到集市出售。英国内战期间，农民和镇民组成当地“棍棒民”组织，保护财产免受双方军队侵扰。1645年战斗波及班普顿，城镇大部分遭到破坏。

english:
Bampur lies on the Bampur River in Iranian Baluchistan, where the river crosses dry plains before draining into the Jaz Murian depression. The town occupies an old route junction southeast of Kerman, with access to water in an otherwise arid region. An ancient citadel stood north of the river, and successive settlements clustered around its strategic position.

Archaeological excavations have identified six occupation phases at Bampur, with pottery and other finds connecting it to the Helmand culture of western Afghanistan and the Jiroft culture of eastern Iran. Those links show that routes across the Iranian plateau and Makran were active long before written histories described the region. Copper, stone and agricultural goods probably moved through the river oasis.

During the medieval period, Baluch tribes, Persian governors and local rulers competed for the province. Shah Mihrab Khan of the Rakshani Baluch waged campaigns through the region, and Bampur long served as a district centre. The old hill fortress fell into ruin, but the town remained a stage between Kerman, Sistan and the coast.
simp_chinese:
班布尔位于伊朗俾路支斯坦的班布尔河畔，河流穿过干燥平原，最终进入贾兹穆里安洼地。城镇处在克尔曼东南的旧道路交会处，在缺水地区控制水源。古代城堡建在河北高丘上，后续聚落围绕这一战略位置发展。

考古发掘在班布尔辨识出六个居住阶段，陶片和其他遗存把当地同阿富汗西部赫尔曼德文化及伊朗东部吉罗夫特文化联系起来。这说明伊朗高原和莫克兰之间的路线在有文字记载以前便已活跃。铜、石料和农产品可能沿河岸绿洲流通。

中世纪时，俾路支部落、波斯总督及地方统治者争夺该省。拉克沙尼俾路支首领沙米赫拉卜汗曾在地区发动战争，班布尔长期充当地方行政中心。旧丘堡虽成废墟，城镇仍是克尔曼、锡斯坦与海岸之间的中继站。

english: The Bamu River runs from the country south of Mount Bosavi through the swamp forests of the Papuan lowlands to the Gulf of Papua. Near its mouth the river broadens into a tidal estuary, fed by tributaries including the Wawoi and Aramia. Bamu, or Bamu Kiwai, is a Papuan language spoken along this river; its varieties include Upper and Lower Bamu.
simp_chinese: 巴穆河从博萨维山以南流出，穿过巴布亚低地的沼泽森林，注入巴布亚湾。河流接纳瓦沃伊河和阿拉米亚河等支流，在河口附近拓宽为受潮汐影响的河口湾。沿河通行的巴穆语又称巴穆基瓦伊语，是一种巴布亚语言，包含上巴穆和下巴穆等方言。

english:
Bamyan lies in a sheltered high valley between the Hindu Kush and the Koh-i-Baba, on a route across the mountains linking Central and South Asia. The great Buddha figures and painted caves cut into the northern cliff recall an earlier Buddhist centre visited by the pilgrim Xuanzang. In the twelfth and early thirteenth centuries the Ghurids made Bamyan the capital of a kingdom that stretched north of the Oxus. The Mongol siege of 1221 brought devastating destruction to the city and its people.

A town reappeared in the Timurid period, though the waning transcontinental caravan trade kept it smaller than its predecessor. Babur mentioned Bamyan as a district centre. In the early nineteenth century travellers found a walled town opposite the Buddha cliff, cultivated valley bottoms, fortified houses and people living in caves. Trade remained important: transit duties brought revenue to the district. The surrounding mountains were home to Hazara communities, while the town itself lay amid competing Afghan and northern Uzbek claims.
simp_chinese:
巴米扬坐落在兴都库什山与巴巴山之间的高山谷地，穿越群山的道路将中亚与南亚联系起来。北侧崖壁上的巨佛和绘有壁画的洞窟，见证了玄奘曾经到访的佛教中心。十二至十三世纪初，古尔王朝以巴米扬为都，其王国北达阿姆河以外。1221年蒙古军围城，城市和居民遭到毁灭性打击。

帖木儿时代，一座城镇在谷地重新出现，但横贯大陆的商队贸易衰落，使它未能恢复到旧城规模。巴布尔曾提到这里是地区治所。十九世纪初的旅行者看到佛像崖对面有一座围墙环绕的小城，谷底土地得到耕种，坚固的宅院散布其间，也有人居住在崖壁洞穴里。贸易仍然重要，过境商品的税收为地方带来收入。周围山区是哈扎拉人的家园，城镇则处在阿富汗与北方乌兹别克势力相互争夺的地带。

english:
Ban Don lies in the Central Highlands of Vietnam within the Srepok River country of Đắk Lắk. The river winds through red basalt soil, forest and cultivated clearings, providing fish, water and a route between highland villages. The name derives from a Lao expression meaning “village of the isle,” and local Rhade and Lao communities shared the river landscape.

A small stone bund on the Srepok served as a meeting point and river crossing. Lao settlers lived there from the nineteenth century, while Rhade communities occupied nearby highland districts and maintained their own longhouse villages and elephant traditions. Forests supplied timber and wild foods, and wet-season floods enriched rice fields along the river.

Canoes, trails and seasonal crossings linked the dispersed settlements. Markets exchanged rice, forest goods and livestock, and highland chiefs negotiated with lowland traders. Ban Don’s identity belongs to this multi-ethnic river country rather than to a single planned town. Elephants were captured and trained in nearby forests. Lao and Rhade households exchanged rice and elephant products. Forest tracks connected highland hamlets.

The later city of Buôn Ma Thuột lies here.
simp_chinese:
班敦位于越南中部高地得乐省的斯雷波克河地区。河流穿过红色玄武岩土、森林和耕作空地，提供鱼、水源和连接高地村庄的路线。地名源自老挝语“岛上村庄”，当地埃地人与老挝社群共同使用河谷。

斯雷波克河上的小石堤既是会合处，也是渡口。十九世纪起老挝移民在此居住，埃地社群则占据邻近高地，维持长屋村寨与大象传统。森林提供木材与野生食物，雨季洪水肥沃沿岸稻田。

独木舟、小径和季节渡口连接分散聚落。市场交换稻米、林产品和牲畜，高地酋长同低地商人协商。班敦身份属于多族群河乡，而非单一规划城镇。附近森林中捕捉和驯养大象，河流仍是族际交换的骨干。老挝与埃地家庭交换稻米和大象制品，季节渡口维持高地往来。林间小径连接高地村落。

后来的邦美蜀市即位于此地。

english: Ban Khon lies in the wooded hill country west of the Mekong, among the valleys of northwestern Laos. Forested sandstone ridges and small streams break up the landscape, separating villages from the wider river corridors. The surrounding country has long been home to a variety of upland and valley communities, whose settlements are linked by paths through the hills and along the tributaries of the Mekong.
simp_chinese: 班孔位于湄公河以西林木茂密的丘陵地带，坐落在老挝西北部的河谷之间。覆盖森林的砂岩山脊和小溪将地貌切割开来，使村落与较宽阔的河流通道相隔。周围地区长期居住着不同的高地与河谷社群，山路和湄公河支流沿岸的道路将各聚落联系起来。

english: Ban Luang Cheng is remembered as an early settlement of the northern Lao highlands. According to local accounts, Tai Lue migrants from Sipsongpanna established a village of this name in the Muang Xay country around 1260. A story about a meeting between villagers cutting bamboo and a monk named Paxay connects the village with the later name of Muang Xay, a place among the wooded valleys of Oudomxay.
simp_chinese: 班銮清被记作老挝北部高地的一处早期聚落。当地记载称，来自西双版纳的傣仂移民约于1260年在孟赛一带建立了这个村庄。另一个故事讲述村民砍竹时遇到名叫巴赛的僧人，并将村庄与后来的孟赛之名联系起来；这一地区位于乌多姆赛林木覆盖的山谷之间。

english: Ban Pa La Ta lies in the wooded hills near the headwaters of the Mae Wong. The river drains the slopes below Khao Mokochu eastward towards the Sakae Krang and the Chao Phraya basin. Mixed deciduous forest covers much of the lower ground, while evergreen trees grow on the higher hills; streams plunge over the rocks at Mae Rewa and other falls.
simp_chinese: 班巴拉达位于梅翁河源头附近的林木山地。河水汇集莫科朱山下的溪流，向东流往沙盖克朗河及昭披耶河流域。低地多为混交落叶林，较高山坡则生长常绿林；梅瑞瓦等瀑布从岩石间跌落。

english:
Ban Phone lies in the lower Mekong country near the Khorat Plateau, a broad upland divided by hills into basins drained by the Mun and Chi rivers. The plateau has thinner rainfall than central Thailand, making rice cultivation dependent on the timing of the monsoon and on local water storage. In the south, the land descends toward the Mekong and the Cambodian plain.

The region was home to early farming communities and later came under Dvaravati and Khmer influence. Temples, roads and rest houses connected the plateau with Angkor, and settled agriculture spread along rivers and tributaries. Local chiefs governed villages through kinship and control of land, while Buddhist monasteries served as centres of learning and ceremony.

During the sixteenth to eighteenth centuries, Lao and Siamese expansion brought the plateau more closely into the Lao kingdoms and the Siamese tributary system. Ban Phone's small size gives it little separate political history, but its location within the lower Mekong network made it part of rice fields, river transport and upland passes. Households depended on the annual flood and monsoon, while officials and monks tied villages to larger courts.

The later city of Sekong lies here.
simp_chinese:
班奉位于湄公河下游地区、呵叻高原附近。高原由丘陵分成数个盆地，蒙河与芝河把水引向湄公河。降水少于泰国中部，稻作依赖季风时机和地方蓄水；南部土地又逐渐降至湄公河与柬埔寨平原。

当地早就有农耕社群，后来受到堕罗钵底和高棉势力影响。寺庙、道路与驿舍把高原同吴哥联系起来，农业沿河流和支流扩展。地方首领依靠亲属关系与土地管理村庄，佛寺则承担教育、仪式和集会功能。

近代早期，老挝和暹罗势力扩张，把高原进一步纳入老挝诸王国与暹罗贡赋体系。班奉规模很小，单独政治记载有限，但其位置使它属于稻田、河运和山地通道组成的湄公河下游世界。

雨季洪水为稻田补给，旱季则迫使居民依靠池塘和河流。僧侣、商贩和官员沿这些路线往来，使小村既保持地方组织，也卷入更广阔的湄公河政治与经济网络。

后来的塞公即位于此地。

english: Bana is a chiefdom in the highland country of the western Cameroon grassfields. Its traditions name Tchokogwe, also called Nza, as founder. On the heights of the Ndumla plateau, local chiefdoms took shape among settlements whose history reaches far into the past; stone tools found on the heights bear witness to much earlier inhabitants. The high ground and valleys form a landscape shared by neighboring communities under their own chiefs.
simp_chinese: 巴纳是喀麦隆西部草原高地的一处酋邦。当地传统称乔科格韦，也叫恩扎，是其创建者。在恩杜姆拉高原的高处，地方酋邦在历史悠久的聚落之间形成；山上发现的石器则见证了更早的居民。高地与河谷构成了邻近社群共同生活的景观，各地有自己的酋长。

english:
The Banaadir Coast faces the Indian Ocean along southern Somalia. Its ports, including Mogadishu, Merca and Barawa, linked inland communities to maritime networks reaching other East African and overseas ports. Coastal towns became centres of commerce and Islamic scholarship.

The traveller Ibn Battuta visited Mogadishu shortly before the period described here, around 1331. He described a prosperous town whose cloth was exported to Egypt and elsewhere. Such weaving and maritime exchange connected the coast to the wider Indian Ocean, while its ports also drew on resources and traders from their hinterland.
simp_chinese:
巴纳迪尔海岸位于索马里南部，面向印度洋。摩加迪沙、梅尔卡和巴拉瓦等港口把内陆社群同通往东非其他港口及海外的海上网络相连，沿岸城镇也成为商业和伊斯兰学术中心。

旅行家伊本·白图泰约于1331年访问摩加迪沙，稍早于本时代。他描述这座繁荣的城镇所产布匹销往埃及等地。织造和海上交换将海岸与更广阔的印度洋世界联系起来，而港口也依靠腹地的资源和商人。

sources.title: Urban woes and pious remedies Sufism in 19th century Benaadir (Somalia).pdf

english:
Banaba is a solitary raised coral island west of the Gilbert chain, small in area but reaching the highest elevation in Kiribati. Its limestone rim and central plateau rise sharply from the equatorial sea. There are no streams and no reliable freshwater lens, so settlement depended on rain gathered in caves and stored with care.

Banaban oral tradition describes settlement in at least three waves. The island was understood as the navel of the world, and its land was held by individuals rather than by a single ruling lineage. Rights to land passed through recognized forms of inheritance and transfer. This unusually detailed tenure system connected families to particular gardens, settlements and places of origin.

Drought remained a persistent threat to the island’s inhabitants and shaped how they used ships and outside contact. Captain Jared Gardner sighted Banaba in 1801, and John Mertho named it Ocean Island after his vessel in 1804. Whalers began calling for water and wood, with the Arabella recorded in 1832. These visits did not displace the island’s land-based order before the phosphate era, but they joined it to wider Pacific shipping routes.
simp_chinese:
巴纳巴是吉尔伯特群岛以西一座孤立的抬升珊瑚岛，面积不大，却拥有基里巴斯最高点。石灰岩边缘与中央台地从赤道海面骤然升起。岛上没有溪流，也没有可靠的淡水透镜，居民只能谨慎收集并储存洞穴中的雨水。

口述传统称岛屿至少经历三波定居。当地人把这里看作世界的中心，土地由个人持有，而非统归某一统治世系。土地权利通过数种得到承认的继承与转让方式传递。这套制度把家庭与特定园地、聚落和祖源地联系起来。

干旱始终威胁岛上居民，也影响他们利用船只的方式。贾里德·加德纳船长于1801年看见巴纳巴，约翰·默索在1804年以“海洋”号为自己的新发现命名。捕鲸船随后为取水和木材而来，1832年有“阿拉贝拉”号的记录。这些访问尚未改变岛上的土地秩序，却把巴纳巴接入更广阔的太平洋航路。

english: Banaba rises above the Pacific west of the Gilbert Islands, a raised coral island rather than a low lagoon atoll. Its inhabitants drew fresh water from a cave on an island without natural streams. In 1801 the American captain Jared Gardner sighted it from the Diana; three years later John Mertho named it Ocean Island after his ship.
simp_chinese: 巴纳巴耸立于吉尔伯特群岛以西的太平洋上，是一座隆起的珊瑚岛，而非低矮的潟湖环礁。岛上没有天然河流，居民从积聚淡水的洞穴取水。1801年，美国船长贾里德·加德纳在黛安娜号上望见此岛；三年后，约翰·默索以自己的船名将其命名为海洋岛。

english: Banader lies in the dry country of Garmsir, south of the lower Helmand valley. Desert plains stretch away from the river, whose waters flow southwest toward the marshes and inland lakes of Sistan. The contrast between the cultivated river corridor and the barren ground beyond is especially marked here, where hot summers and scarce rainfall shape the landscape of southern Afghanistan.
simp_chinese: 巴纳德位于加姆塞尔的干旱地带，在赫尔曼德河下游河谷以南。荒漠平原从河边向远方延伸，河水则向西南流入锡斯坦的沼泽与内陆湖泊。这里的河谷耕作地带与外围荒地形成鲜明对照，酷热的夏季和稀少的降雨塑造了阿富汗南部的景观。

english:
Banamba country lies in dry grassland north of Koulikoro, on the southern edge of the Sahel between the Niger valley and the inland frontier. Seasonal rains support millet and pasture, while wells determine where people and herds can remain during dry months. Roads crossing this open country connect the river lands with the Sahara-facing trade routes.

This frontier lay between the Bamana Empire and Kaarta. Marka and Soninke merchants moved grain, salt, cloth and other goods through the region, while Fulani herders followed seasonal pasture. Local communities negotiated passage, water rights and protection with the stronger states around them.

Market routes, cattle trails and wells made the open grassland a meeting zone between farming villages and mobile pastoralists. Its value came from movement across the dry Sahel rather than from a single permanent town. Drought, locusts and raids could empty the routes, while years of good rain revived the wells and markets. Protection agreements and familiarity with grazing determined which households could remain.
simp_chinese:
巴南巴地区位于库利科罗以北的干燥草原，处在尼日尔河谷与萨赫勒内陆边地之间。季节降雨维持粟作和牧场，水井决定人物与畜群在旱月能够停留何处。穿越开阔乡间的道路把河岸地区同面向撒哈拉的贸易路线连接起来。

这一边疆位于巴马纳帝国与卡尔塔之间。马尔卡与索宁克商人运输谷物、盐、布匹和其他货物，富拉尼牧民则追逐季节性牧草。地方社群围绕通行、水源权利和保护，同周边较强国家不断协商。

市场道路、牛道和水井使开阔草原成为农业村庄与流动牧民相会之处。它的价值来自穿越干燥萨赫勒的移动，而非单一永久城镇。干旱、蝗灾和袭击会让道路暂时空寂，雨量充足的年份又使水井和市场恢复活力。保护约定与对牧场的熟悉程度，决定哪些家庭能够留在当地。这些选择长期塑造道路。

english: South of Chongqing, the country known as Banan extends from the Yangtze into wooded hills and valleys. It formed part of the old Ba County, whose seat lay in the city itself. Among the market towns of this district, Fengsheng stood near the meeting of roads from Ba, Fuling and Nanchuan, and became a busy stopping place for merchants travelling overland through the hills.
simp_chinese: 重庆以南的巴南地区从长江岸边延伸至林木覆盖的丘陵与山谷。这里曾属古老的巴县，县治则设在重庆城内。当地的丰盛场位于巴县、涪陵和南川交界附近，是山间陆路商旅的重要落脚地，也是旧巴县的一处繁忙市镇。

english:
The Banana Islands lie off the mountainous peninsula of Sierra Leone, separated from the mainland by a narrow channel. Their sheltered anchorages formed part of a chain of coastal trading places stretching north and south of the Sierra Leone estuary. During the eighteenth century British and Afro-European dealers on the islands sold captives to ships engaged in the Atlantic slave trade. The islands were among the smaller stations at which vessels gathered people forcibly taken from communities along the coast and in the interior.

The later city of Freetown lies here.
simp_chinese:
香蕉群岛位于多山的塞拉利昂半岛外，一条狭窄水道将它们与大陆隔开。岛上的避风锚地属于沿塞拉利昂河口南北延伸的海岸贸易网络。十八世纪，岛上的英国及非欧混血商人向大西洋奴隶船贩卖俘虏。群岛是众多较小的交易站之一，船只在这里收集从沿海和内陆社群被强行带走的人。

后来的弗里敦即位于此地。

english: Banaro is a Papuan language of the Sepik region in northern New Guinea. Its speakers inhabit the country around tributaries flowing towards the great river, amid forest and low-lying wetlands. The Sepik basin contains numerous language communities, whose villages are connected by river channels as well as paths through the forest.
simp_chinese: 巴纳罗语是新几内亚北部塞皮克地区的一种巴布亚语言。使用者居住在流向大河的支流一带，周围有森林与低洼湿地。塞皮克流域分布着众多语言社群，河道和穿林小径将各村落联系起来。

english: Banaz lies east of Uşak in a fertile plain of the western Anatolian interior. Mounds near villages such as Ahat and Oturak preserve traces of much older settlement. The district passed into Seljuk hands in the twelfth century and later belonged to the Germiyanid lands before Ottoman expansion. Under the Ottomans Banaz formed a district of Uşak, its villages occupying the plain and surrounding high ground.
simp_chinese: 巴纳兹位于乌沙克以东，坐落在安纳托利亚西部内陆的肥沃平原。阿哈特和奥图拉克等村庄附近的遗址丘保留了更早聚落的痕迹。十二世纪该地区进入塞尔柱人手中，后来属于盖尔米扬领地，再经历奥斯曼扩张。奥斯曼时期，巴纳兹是乌沙克下属辖区，村庄分布于平原和周围高地。

english: Banbishan lies in the mountain country of the Luan River basin. The Sa River and its southern headstream meet in the Banbishan area, carrying water down from the surrounding hills. Archaeological finds at Banbishan attest to human settlement in this part of the mountains as early as the Neolithic.
simp_chinese: 半壁山位于滦河流域的山地。潵河与其南源在半壁山一带汇合，将周围山岭的水流带向下游。半壁山出土的文物显示，早在新石器时代，这片山地已有居民活动。

english:
Banbury is a market town on the River Cherwell in northern Oxfordshire. Its medieval prosperity rested on wool, and two old routes met here: the Salt Way and Banbury Lane, which ran westward toward the Fosse Way. The Bishop of Lincoln held the town at the time of Domesday Book; his successor Alexander began building Banbury Castle in 1135. In 1554 Queen Mary I granted a royal charter incorporating Banbury as a borough.

During the English Civil War the castle held a royalist garrison despite strong Parliamentarian sympathies in the town. It was besieged and demolished after the war. More than a century later, the Oxford Canal reached Banbury in 1778, bringing Warwickshire coal by water; the canal opened through to Oxford in 1790.
simp_chinese:
班伯里是牛津郡北部彻韦尔河畔的集镇。中世纪的繁荣依靠羊毛，盐道与通往福斯大道的班伯里路在此交会。《末日审判书》编纂时，城镇属于林肯主教；继任主教亚历山大于1135年开始修建班伯里城堡。1554年，玛丽一世颁布特许状，使班伯里成为自治市镇。

英国内战期间，尽管城中许多人支持议会，城堡仍由保王派驻军把守。它经历围攻，战后被拆毁。一个多世纪后，牛津运河于1778年通抵班伯里，经水路运来沃里克郡煤炭；1790年，运河全线通至牛津。

english:
Banda stands on the Ken River in Bundelkhand, with the fort of Bhuragarh on the opposite bank. It became a centre of the Bundela chiefs and later of a line of nawabs connected to the Maratha Peshwas. The river and its crossings placed the town within the network of forts and territories contested by Bundela, Maratha and Mughal powers.

After the death of the Bundela chief Chhatrasal, his son Jagat Raj received territory around Banda. In 1791 Ali Bahadur, a descendant of Peshwa Baji Rao, took control of the town and became Nawab of Banda. He died during an attempt to capture Kalinjar in 1802. His son Shamsher Bahadur made Banda his residence but was defeated by British forces and accepted their supremacy in 1804.
simp_chinese:
班达位于本德尔肯德的肯河畔，对岸是布拉加尔堡。它先后成为本德拉首领和与马拉塔佩什瓦家族有关的纳瓦卜的中心。河流及其渡口使城镇处在本德拉、马拉塔和莫卧儿势力争夺的堡垒与领地网络之中。

本德拉首领查特拉萨尔去世后，其子贾加特·拉杰获得班达附近领土。1791年，佩什瓦巴吉·拉奥的后代阿里·巴哈杜尔控制此地，成为班达纳瓦卜。他于1802年攻打卡林贾尔时去世。其子沙姆谢尔·巴哈杜尔以班达为驻地，却在1804年被英国军队击败，接受英国宗主权。

english: Banda Ahenkro is the chief town of a group of Nafana communities in the wooded country of Banda. Its earlier name, Serminakuu, is said to have referred to clumps of grass. Local tradition connects the name Banda with warriors allied to Asante: many were Muslims who prayed through the night, and their wakefulness gave rise to a name explained as “they did not sleep.” The wider Banda region had long-standing connections with the trade routes that joined the forest edge to lands farther north.
simp_chinese: 班达阿亨克罗是班达林地中一组纳法纳社群的首席城镇。相传它早先的名字塞尔米纳库意为一丛丛草。当地传统将班达之名与阿散蒂的盟军联系起来：这些战士中有许多穆斯林，夜间祈祷而不眠，因此得名，意为“他们不睡觉”。更广阔的班达地区很早便与连接森林边缘和北方地区的商路有所往来。

english:
The Banda Archipelago belongs to the maritime world of Maluku, the Indonesian islands long associated with spices and exchange. Centuries before European ships entered the region, nutmeg, mace and other goods traveled through Asian trading networks where Javanese and regional merchants took part. Archipelago geography made sea travel the ordinary means of linking producers, markets and distant ports.

Portuguese forces captured Malacca in 1511 and reached Maluku the next year in search of control over the spice trade. Dutch expeditions followed during the 1590s. In 1602, competing Dutch companies combined into the Vereenigde Oost-Indische Compagnie, whose charter allowed it to wage war, build fortresses and conclude treaties across Asia. Its consolidation made the small islands a center of rivalry out of proportion to their land area.

The surrounding waters contain coral reefs, seagrass and mangroves, while the many islands support dense tropical vegetation and varied habitats. Settlement follows sheltered coasts and accessible reefs, and boats remain essential for moving between communities. From this sea, Banda's history stretches from early regional commerce through colonial monopoly and into the later Indonesian archipelago.
simp_chinese:
班达群岛属于摩鹿加海洋世界，这一带印度尼西亚岛屿长期因香料和商品交换而闻名。早在欧洲船只进入之前，肉豆蔻、肉豆蔻衣等货物便已通过爪哇及区域商人参与的亚洲贸易网络流通。群岛地理使海路成为连接产地、市场和远方港口的最常见方式。

葡萄牙军队于1511年攻占马六甲，次年为寻求控制香料贸易而抵达摩鹿加。1590年代，荷兰远征队继而到来。1602年，彼此竞争的荷兰公司合并为荷兰东印度公司，其特许权允许公司在亚洲发动战争、修建堡垒并订立条约。这种力量的集中，使面积不大的群岛成为远超其陆地规模的利益争夺中心。

周围海域有珊瑚礁、海草和红树林，众多岛屿则覆盖茂密热带植被，形成多样生境。聚落多依附避风海岸和容易到达的礁区，船只仍是社区之间往来的基本工具。从这片海望去，班达的历史由早期区域商贸延伸到殖民垄断，最后进入后来印度尼西亚群岛。

english:
The Banda Islands, ten small volcanic islands in the Banda Sea south of Seram, were until the nineteenth century the world's only source of nutmeg and mace. They were governed by councils of orang kaya, 'rich men', and their own ships carried the spices west to Malacca, returning with rice and with cloth from Java, India and the Lesser Sundas.

The Dutch wanted the trade for themselves. In 1609, when Admiral Verhoeff came to build a fort on Banda Neira, the orang kaya lured him to a parley and killed him with dozens of his men; among those who escaped was a young merchant, Jan Pieterszoon Coen. The Dutch raised Fort Belgica above the harbour in 1611, and in 1621 Coen returned to conquer the islands.
simp_chinese:
班达群岛是斯兰岛以南班达海中的十座火山小岛，直到十九世纪中叶仍是世界上肉豆蔻和肉豆蔻衣的唯一产地。岛上由称作“奥朗卡亚”（意为“富人”）的长老共同治理，本地船只把香料运往马六甲，换回大米以及爪哇、印度和小巽他群岛的布匹。

荷兰人想独占这门生意。1609年，海军司令费尔胡夫来班达内拉岛修筑要塞，奥朗卡亚借谈判之名把他诱入埋伏，连同数十名随从一并杀死，逃脱的人中有年轻商人扬·彼得松·科恩。1611年，荷兰人在港口上方修建贝尔吉卡堡；1621年，科恩率军卷土重来，征服了群岛。

english: The Banda Sea reaches the islands southeast of Sulawesi, including the Tukang Besi group. Coral reefs surround their shores, and deep waters lie to the north and east of the island chain. Fishing communities use the marine resources of these seas, whose passages connect Sulawesi's southeastern coast with the islands farther east.
simp_chinese: 班达海延伸至苏拉威西东南方诸岛，包括图康勿西群岛。珊瑚礁环绕岛岸，岛链北面与东面是深水海域。渔民利用这里丰富的海洋资源，岛间水道将苏拉威西东南岸与更东方的岛屿相连。

english: Between southeastern Sulawesi and the islands of Maluku lies the broad Banda Sea. The Tukang Besi Islands and their reefs border its western waters, while the Banda Islands farther east were renowned for nutmeg and mace. Sailors crossed these seas between island shores, carrying the spices that made Banda known to merchants across Asia.
simp_chinese: 苏拉威西东南部与马鲁古群岛之间是广阔的班达海。图康勿西群岛及其珊瑚礁位于西部水域边缘，更东面的班达群岛则以肉豆蔻和肉豆蔻皮闻名。水手在岛岸之间穿越海域，运送使班达为亚洲商人所知的香料。

english:
South of Buru, the northern Banda Sea lies between the island shores of the Moluccas. Buru, Ambon and Seram frame the water to the north, their forested interiors contrasting with the open basin offshore. These islands lie within Wallacea, where species from Asia and Australasia coexist without either side of the archipelago ever having joined the two continents.

Buru and Seram each support distinct tropical moist forest ecoregions. This separation matters because the islands' terrestrial habitats are as varied as the sea between them. The Banda-Flores marine ecoregion, rich in reefs and deep water, connects those land margins to the wider Coral Triangle. Island channels also create many local maritime conditions rather than one uniform tropical sea.

The Banda Islands rise within these waters, and Gunung Api and Manuk remain active volcanoes. Their slopes show that the sea's calm appearance rests on continuing tectonic movement. Along the northern approach, forest, reef, deep water and volcanic landforms are packed into a comparatively short distance. This makes the waters south of Buru a meeting place for sharply different habitats and histories.
simp_chinese:
布鲁岛以南，班达海北部位于摩鹿加诸岛的岸缘之间。布鲁、安汶和塞兰从北方围住海面，森林覆盖的岛内景观与岸外开阔盆地相互映衬。这些岛屿属于华莱西亚；亚洲与澳大拉西亚记载的生物在此并存，而群岛并未同两侧大陆形成陆地连接。

布鲁和塞兰分别拥有不同的热带湿润森林生态区。这种差异说明，岛上陆地生境同其间海洋一样多样。班达海—弗洛勒斯海海洋生态区包括珊瑚礁和深水环境，把岛岸同更广的珊瑚三角区连接起来。岛间水道也形成许多局地海况，使这里并非均一的热带海面。

班达群岛在附近海中隆起，阿皮火山与马努克仍是活火山。它们证明看似平静的海面之下延续着构造运动。在北部入口一带，森林、珊瑚礁、深水和火山地貌集中在不长距离内，因此布鲁以南的水域汇合了差异鲜明的生活环境与区域历史。

english: The Banda Sea washes the southern and western shores of Buru, one of the mountainous islands of Maluku. To the southeast lie the Banda Islands, the historic home of nutmeg and mace. These valuable spices brought traders across the surrounding seas, connecting the islands' coasts with markets throughout Asia and, later, Europe.
simp_chinese: 班达海冲刷着布鲁岛的南岸与西岸。布鲁是多山的马鲁古群岛之一，其东南方有班达群岛，历史上是肉豆蔻和肉豆蔻皮的产地。这些珍贵香料吸引商人穿越周围海域，将岛屿海岸与亚洲乃至后来的欧洲市场相连。

english: In the Banda Sea, open water separates the spice islands from Buru, Seram and their neighbours. The Banda Islands produced nutmeg and mace, commodities sought by merchants who followed seasonal winds among the islands. Their sea routes tied Banda to other ports of Maluku and to more distant markets, making this scattered archipelago a centre of a far-reaching trade.
simp_chinese: 班达海的开阔水面将香料群岛与布鲁、塞兰等邻岛分隔。班达群岛出产肉豆蔻和肉豆蔻皮，商人顺着季风在诸岛之间航行，寻找这些货物。海路将班达与马鲁古其他港口及更远的市场相连，使这片散布的群岛成为远距离贸易中心。

english: The Banda Sea spreads between the islands of eastern Indonesia, linking the Banda Islands with the waters towards Aru. Banda was famed for nutmeg and mace, spices that attracted merchants from across Asia and later European powers. Bandanese traders also travelled east to obtain pearls and other prized products from Aru, carrying them back through a network of island ports.
simp_chinese: 班达海展开于印度尼西亚东部诸岛之间，连接班达群岛与通往阿鲁的水域。班达以肉豆蔻和肉豆蔻皮闻名，这些香料吸引了亚洲各地的商人，后来也引来欧洲势力。班达商人还向东航行，到阿鲁收购珍珠等珍贵货物，再通过群岛港口的贸易网络运回。

english: Bandafassi lies among the wooded hills of the upper Gambia basin, on the western approaches to the Futa Jalon highlands. The surrounding country is home to Bedik, Bassari and other communities whose villages occupy valleys and hilltops. Cultivation of millet and other crops has long formed part of life here, alongside the keeping of livestock. The hills contain sacred places associated with local religious traditions, while the varied settlements of the region reflect a long history of movement and coexistence among neighbouring peoples.
simp_chinese: 班达法西位于冈比亚河上游流域的林木丘陵间，靠近富塔贾隆高地西侧。周边的贝迪克、巴萨里等社群在河谷和山顶建立村落，长期种植小米等作物，也饲养牲畜。山中有与当地宗教传统相联系的圣地，山顶村落与谷地农田共同构成这片多样的景观。各具特色的聚落反映出邻近族群迁徙与共处的漫长历史。

english: The Bandama meets the sea among lagoons at Lahou. Its course through the forest gave local merchants access to inland markets, and canoes carried goods between the river and the coast. Ivory and captive people passed through Lahou, while by the early nineteenth century gold also contributed to a flourishing trade. European visitors sought a foothold on shore, but local merchants guarded their position as intermediaries between ships and the interior.
simp_chinese: 班达马河在拉乌附近的潟湖之间入海。河流穿过森林，使当地商人能够抵达内陆市场；独木舟在河道与海岸之间运送货物。象牙和被俘人口经拉乌流转，到十九世纪初，黄金也推动了繁荣的贸易。欧洲访客希望在岸上取得据点，但当地商人维护自己作为船只与内陆之间中间人的地位。

english:
Bandar Aceh stands near the northern tip of Sumatra, where the Indian Ocean meets the approaches to the Malacca Strait. As the capital of the Aceh Sultanate, it became a gathering place for merchants and Muslim scholars from India, the Middle East and Southeast Asia. Pepper from Sumatra drew ships to its harbor, while its rulers competed with Portuguese Malacca and Johor for influence over the strait. After the Portuguese capture of Malacca in 1511, Muslim merchants increasingly turned to Aceh, strengthening the port and its commercial links.

In the sixteenth century Sultan Ali Mughayat Syah expanded Aceh's authority along the Sumatran coast, taking Pasai and other ports. His successors attacked Portuguese positions across the water and sought military assistance from the Ottoman Empire. Under Iskandar Muda, who ruled from 1607 to 1636, Aceh extended its reach into the Malay Peninsula, although an attack on Malacca in 1629 ended in disaster for its fleet. He also established a body of court regulations known as Adat Meukuta Alam, drawing on the authority of custom.

After Iskandar Muda's successor, a succession of women ruled as sultanas. The court remained a center of Islamic learning, even as distant territories gained greater independence. In the early nineteenth century pepper continued to enrich the ports of Aceh, and rulers at the capital sought to bring powerful coastal chiefs more firmly under their authority.
simp_chinese:
班达亚齐位于苏门答腊北端附近，印度洋在此接近马六甲海峡。作为亚齐苏丹国的都城，它成为印度、中东和东南亚商人与穆斯林学者的聚会之地。苏门答腊胡椒吸引船只来到港口，统治者则与葡萄牙人的马六甲和柔佛争夺海峡的影响力。1511年葡萄牙人攻占马六甲后，穆斯林商人日益转向亚齐，增强了港口及其商业联系。

十六世纪，阿里·穆加亚特沙苏丹沿苏门答腊海岸扩张权力，占据巴赛等港口。继承者进攻海峡对岸的葡萄牙据点，并向奥斯曼帝国寻求军事援助。1607至1636年在位的依斯干达·穆达将亚齐势力伸入马来半岛，但1629年进攻马六甲时，其舰队遭遇惨败。他还制定了称为《皇冠之国习惯法》的宫廷规章。

依斯干达·穆达的继承者之后，数位女性先后以苏丹娜身份执政。尽管远方领地获得更大独立性，宫廷仍是伊斯兰学术中心。十九世纪初，胡椒继续使亚齐港口富裕，都城统治者也试图更稳固地控制势力强大的沿海首领。

english: Bandar-e Charak is a port on the Persian Gulf coast opposite Kish Island. The nearby villages and the island belonged to a network of Arabic-speaking communities along the Iranian shore. In 1830 an account recorded members of the Al Ali tribe at Charak, some of whom were seafarers. The short crossing to Kish joined the port to an island long involved in Gulf commerce.
simp_chinese: 查拉克港位于波斯湾伊朗海岸，与基什岛隔海相望。港口、附近村落及岛屿属于伊朗沿岸阿拉伯语社群的网络。1830年的一份记载提到阿勒阿里部族居住在查拉克，其中一些人以海航为业。短短的海路把港口同长期参与海湾贸易的基什岛连接起来。

english: Bandar Deylam stands on the northern shore of the Persian Gulf, where a low coastal plain meets the sea. North of the town lie the remains of Mahruyan, a medieval port at the end of a road leading towards the Iranian interior. Its ruined walls and scattered pottery, including Chinese wares, recall a time when ships and merchants linked this shore with distant markets. The port itself and the later settlement of Deylam were distinct places on the same coast.
simp_chinese: 代拉姆港坐落于波斯湾北岸，低平的海岸平原在这里与大海相接。城镇以北是中世纪港口马赫鲁扬的遗址，它位于通往伊朗内陆的道路尽头。废弃的墙垣与散落的陶片，其中包括中国瓷器，见证了船只和商人将这片海岸与远方市场联系起来的时代。古港与后来的代拉姆是同一海岸上的两处不同聚落。

english: Bandar Deyr is a port on the northern shore of the Persian Gulf, south of Bushehr. Its low coast faces shallow waters rich in fish and prawns, while dry hills rise inland. Fishing and maritime commerce have linked the settlement to other harbours around the Gulf. Boats leave from the shore for the fishing grounds, and coastal traffic follows a long chain of ports between the mouths of Mesopotamian rivers and the Strait of Hormuz.
simp_chinese: 代尔港位于波斯湾北岸、布什尔以南。低平海岸面向盛产鱼虾的浅海，内陆则升起干旱丘陵。捕鱼与海上贸易将聚落同海湾周围其他港口联系起来。船只从岸边驶往渔场，沿海交通则经过美索不达米亚河口与霍尔木兹海峡之间的一连串港口。

sources.title: Salehi (1999) - A Strategic Analysis of Carp Culture Development in Iran.pdf

english:
Bandar-e Anzali lies on the Caspian shore of Gilan. Anzali Gulf gives the city a sheltered approach from the inland sea, long used by trading vessels and fishing boats. The harbor is therefore more than a coastal edge: it is a meeting point between Caspian navigation and the wet lowlands behind the town.

The surrounding climate is exceptionally humid, with hot summers and cool, rainy winters. Heavy autumn and early winter rain drains from the Elburz Mountains, creating conditions suited to rice and tea. The green, water-rich country contrasts sharply with the arid interior usually associated with Iran and gives the port a productive agricultural hinterland.

Anzali’s old settlement history reaches back to the Cadusii, while the name developed through forms such as Anzalag. Its enduring character arises from the safe gulf, the fisheries, and the exchange between Caspian vessels and Gilan’s irrigated fields.
simp_chinese:
安扎里港位于吉兰的里海沿岸。安扎里湾为来自里海的船只提供避风处，长期供商船和渔船使用，使港口成为海上航行与湿润低地之间的交会点。当地气候极为湿润，夏季炎热，冬季寒冷多雨。

秋末冬初的降水从厄尔布尔士山地排入平原，为水稻和茶叶等需水作物提供条件。与伊朗常见印象中的干旱内陆相比，安扎里拥有绿色而多水的腹地。城市历史上曾与卡杜西人有关，地名也在安扎拉格等形式中演变。

避风海湾、渔业以及里海船只同吉兰稻田之间的联系，共同塑造了安扎里的长期性格。

english:
Jask lies on the Gulf of Oman coast of Hormozgan, where the open sea meets the arid Makran shore. Its exposed harbor has little fresh water, but the position outside the Strait of Hormuz made it valuable for ships approaching the enclosed Persian Gulf. Fishermen used monsoon winds and coastal currents to work the sea.

In 1616 an East India Company ship carrying the company’s first shipment arrived from India. English merchants founded a trading post three years later, and Jask became their main commercial port for central Iran until Bandar Abbas took over. Portuguese attempts to block English ships led to fighting in the late 1620s, ending in their defeat near Jask.

Local Baluch communities supplied food, water and guides, while ships exchanged cloth, metals, spices and grain. The route linked the Indian Ocean with the interior through Makran and Persian roads. Jask’s identity comes from this exposed coastal gateway and the struggle for maritime access outside Hormuz. Fishing villages supplied passing ships. Local boats carried fish and dates.
simp_chinese:
贾斯克位于霍尔木兹甘省阿曼湾海岸，开阔海洋与干旱马克兰海岸相接。港口暴露、淡水稀少，但位于霍尔木兹海峡外，对进入波斯湾的船只具有价值。渔民利用季风和沿岸海流作业。

1616年，一艘载有东印度公司首批货物的船只从印度抵达。三年后英国商人建立商站，贾斯克直到阿巴斯港崛起前都是他们同伊朗中部贸易的主要港口。葡萄牙人试图拦截英国船只，十七世纪二十年代后期在贾斯克附近战败。

当地俾路支社群提供食物、水和向导，船只交换布匹、金属、香料与谷物。路线经马克兰和波斯道路连接印度洋与内地。贾斯克身份来自这座暴露的海岸门户，也来自霍尔木兹海峡外围绕海上准入的竞争。渔村为过往船只补给，独桅帆船沿季节风往返印度洋。当地船只运输鱼和枣椰。

english: Bandar Khamir lies on the Persian Gulf coast opposite Qeshm Island, beside the sheltered channels of Khuran. Mangrove forests grow in the tidal waters between the mainland and the island, their roots exposed as the sea falls and covered again at high tide. The sheltered strait supports fish and birds, while boats can pass between the mangroves and the open Gulf. The port stands on a coast long connected by sea to Hormuz and the harbours of Arabia.
simp_chinese: 哈米尔港位于波斯湾海岸，隔海面对格什姆岛，毗邻受庇护的胡兰水道。大陆与岛屿之间的潮水中生长着红树林，退潮时树根露出，涨潮又被海水覆盖。海峡为鱼类和鸟类提供栖息地，船只可在红树林与外海之间穿行。这片海岸长期通过海路连接霍尔木兹与阿拉伯诸港。

english:
Bandar Lengeh lies on the northern shore of the Persian Gulf, west of the Strait of Hormuz. The port faces the islands and trading towns across the water, while dry mountains separate the coast from the interior of Fars. Its sheltered anchorage supported boats engaged in the commerce and fishing of the Gulf.

In the eighteenth century the port was home to Huwala Arab communities. A Dutch account of 1756 described Marzuqi inhabitants who traded in charcoal and firewood, carrying these goods to other places around the Gulf. By the early nineteenth century the Qawasim, whose power extended across both shores, were associated with Lengeh. The small port's fortunes were shaped by these seafaring networks and by the changing authority of rulers on the Persian mainland.
simp_chinese:
伦盖港位于波斯湾北岸、霍尔木兹海峡以西，面向海对岸的岛屿和贸易城镇。干旱山脉将海岸与法尔斯内陆分隔，受庇护的锚地供从事海湾贸易和捕鱼的船只停泊。

十八世纪，港口居住着胡瓦拉阿拉伯社群。1756年的荷兰记述称，马尔祖基居民贩卖木炭与木柴，将货物运往海湾各地。到十九世纪初，势力横跨海湾两岸的卡瓦西姆人与伦盖联系密切。这座小港的命运受到海上网络以及波斯大陆统治权变化的共同影响。

english: Bandar-e Rig stands on the Persian Gulf opposite the island of Kharg. In the eighteenth century its ruler Mir Muhanna challenged the Dutch East India Company, which had established itself on the island. After blockading the Dutch garrison, he captured its fort on 1 January 1766. Control of Kharg gave the ruler of Bandar-e Rig a base from which to act against shipping in the northern Gulf.
simp_chinese: 里格港位于波斯湾沿岸，与哈尔格岛隔海相望。十八世纪，港口统治者米尔·穆汉纳挑战在岛上立足的荷兰东印度公司。他封锁荷兰守军，并于1766年1月1日夺取堡垒。控制哈尔格岛后，里格港的统治者获得了干预海湾北部航运的据点。

english: Bandar Beyla is a coastal settlement on the Indian Ocean side of the Somali peninsula. The dry hinterland meets a shore exposed to the changing winds and currents of the monsoon. Fishing and maritime exchange have long drawn people to this coast, while routes inland lead towards the pastoral country of northeastern Somalia. The harbour belongs to a chain of small ports around the Horn of Africa.
simp_chinese: 班达尔贝拉是索马里半岛印度洋一侧的海岸聚落。干旱腹地在此与海岸相接，海岸受到季风及其变化的海流影响。渔业与海上交换长期吸引人们来到这里；通往内陆的道路则连接索马里东北部的牧区。港湾是非洲之角沿岸一系列小港口的一部分。

english: Bahía de Banderas opens onto Mexico's Pacific coast between Punta Mita in the north and Cabo Corrientes in the south.
